products.title: Ripcords Premium Resistance Bands
products.body_html:
You've seen the videos. Cheap resistance band snaps mid-rep, the person using them is knocked to another planet, everyone watching laughs, our social media guy saves it to make an ad. Don't let this be you.

Ripcords are premium tube bands with a real rubber grip moulded connected to every cord. Nothing to attach, nothing to lose, nothing to regret. You grab it and go.

REAL RUBBER HANDLES. Not foam. Not plastic. Not a clip-on that migrates south halfway through a set. The grip is fastened securely to the cord with ergonomic rubber that doesn’t break down like foam or crack like plastic. There on rep one and still there on rep one hundred.

THREE ANCHORS. EVERY ANGLE. ANYWHERE. Here's where Ripcords do something most tube bands can't:

  • Advanced Door Anchor - A soft-foam head that grips the top or bottom of the door frame. Set it high for cable pull-downs and face pulls. Set it low for rotational work and upward cable movements. If you've ever been stuck doing only incline presses because your anchor only fits over the top of the door, this is the one.
  • Standard Door Anchor - Slots anywhere on the door frame for a quick, no-fuss setup. In and training in under 30 seconds.
  • Versatility Anchor - Loops around a rack upright, a beam, a post, a tree or a fence post. Works anywhere with something solid to wrap around. 

SEVEN TENSIONS. COLOUR-CODED. Yellow (very light, 3-8 lbs / 1.4-3.6 kg) up through Platinum (ultra extreme, 62–90 lbs / 28-41 kg). Rehab-light to seriously strong, all in the same system.

One look at the resistance chart and you know exactly which colour you need.

  • Yellow: extreme beginners, light mobility work.
  • Orange: warming up.
  • Green, Red and Blue: your working sets.
  • Black/Platinum: primarily for one-sided work: Anchor one side, loop it through, and use it mostly for rotational work.

Pick a single cord to fill a gap in your current setup, or step into a full set to cover the whole range.

Heavy-duty tubing built for daily use — none of the thin, sticky, disintegrates-in-a-warm-bag rubber that fills the bargain-bin reviews. A hundred-plus exercises. A setup that fits in a bag. A cable machine that lives in a doorway.

Already training with fabric resistance bands or mini bands? Ripcords are a different tool. Tube bands with cable-machine mechanics rather than flat loop bands for barbell work and bodyweight training.

Every Ripcord is backed by a LIMITED LIFETIME WARRANTY and a 90-DAY SATISFACTION GUARANTEE for home use. Need a replacement within 90 days? We cover it — product and shipping. After 90 days, pay shipping only.

90 day warranty coverage for commercial use. Train hard. We've got the rest.

Want to take cable-style resistance training even further? The Human Trainer turns suspension bodyweight work and resistance band training into a full-body system. Worth having all three. Find your tension and start pulling.

products.title: Human Trainer Bodyweight Suspension System
products.body_html:
Your training shouldn't be stuck wherever your gym is. The Human Trainer Essential Kit is a full bodyweight training system that lives in a mesh bag. Loop it over a door, a beam, a squat rack, or a tree at the park — you've got a few hundred exercises ready to go. No machines. No commute. Just you versus gravity.

THE DUAL-ANCHOR SYSTEM gives two independent anchor points. Two independent straps. Nothing converges into one spot to saw at your wrists, and each side moves on its own, so push-ups, dips, rows, and presses all feel cleaner and more stable than they ever do on a single-anchor trainer. This is the thing that separates the Human Trainer from everything else at this price point. Feel it on rep one.

FIVE D-RINGS. ZERO WASTED TIME. Each strap has five D-rings for height adjustment: unclip, snap into the next ring, keep moving. No cam buckle fighting. No time bleeding between exercises.

Here's the part nobody expects: change the height on one side, then the other, and both land at exactly the same position automatically. No going back and forth to eyeball it like you would with Olympic rings or other dual-anchor systems. (The cam buckle is still there for micro-adjustments when you want the length exact.)

500 LBS / 227 KG CAPACITY PER STRAP. Industrial nylon webbing that doesn't wobble, slip, or give you that stomach-drop feeling mid-rep. Lean into a heavy row. Throw your full bodyweight at a pull. The straps have you. Your anchor point is the only thing worth double-checking.

THE DOOR ANCHOR IS BUILT IN. Not a separate piece to buy, fumble with, or leave behind in a hotel room. The door anchor is integrated directly into the ends of both the main straps. Add the Short Versatility anchors for more options: on a rack, over a beam, or around a post. One kit. Every environment.

REAL RUBBER HANDLES. Not foam that turns into a sponge. Not hard plastic. Real rubber, fused to a durable foot cradle, one piece that flips from a press to a suspended plank to a hamstring curl without swapping anything out. Palms soaked? The grip stays. And because every strap has five D-rings, you can clip two sets on at once and run a superset without resetting your rig.

Start with the Human Trainer Essential Kit for presses, rows, and suspended core work. 

The Essential Kit ships with everything you need to start training on day one:

  • 2× Main straps with integrated door anchors
  • 2× Short versatility anchors with integrated door anchors (loop over a rack, beam, or post — or clip straight into a door)
  • 2× Integrated foot-cradle handles — rubber grip, durable cradle, one piece
  • 1× Detailed user manual with exercise demos
  • 1× Mesh carry bag

Upgrade to the Complete Training kit to add three Ripcords — Orange, Red, and Blue (light to very heavy) — with a Standard Door Anchor that turns any door into a cable station for curls, presses, rows, and rotations. Then the Leg Cords (Yellow and Green) strap around your ankles for warm-ups and lower-body work.

Every order comes with 30 days free of the B.o.S. Training App for new users, and the detailed manual ships in the box, so you're ready to move on day one.

IMPORTANT: If training with a door anchor, position yourself so the door opens away from you, not toward you. Training in the wrong direction may cause the door to pull open under load.

The Human Trainer Bodyweight Suspension System by Bells of Steel features resistance bands with handles in multiple vibrant colors, two strap harnesses in blue and green, black straps, and a sleek black carrying bag—all arranged on a white background—offering a versatile, portable gym and bodyweight training solution you can take anywhere.

products.title: Leg Cords
products.body_html:
If you've ever spent half a squat set yanking a glute band back up your thighs, you already know the problem. Fabric and rubber loops roll. They slide. They pinch. Leg Cords don't, because they don't sit on your thighs at all.

A Leg Cord attaches at the ankle with an extra-large velcro strap that fits every ankle size. The resistance works from down low, where it belongs. As it's anchored at your ankle, it physically can't ride up or slide down. Through lunges, squats, lateral band walks, kickbacks, hip abductions, fire hydrants, and jumping jacks, it stays exactly where you put it.

PROGRESSIVE, COLOUR-CODED TENSION. Five levels run from Yellow (very light, 3–8 lbs / 1.4–3.6 kg) up through Black Sniper (extreme, 42-62 lbs / 19.1-28.1 kgs) — the load builds smoothly as the cord stretches, so you're actually progressing instead of buying loop after loop that all feel about the same. One glance at the tension chart tells you exactly which colour you need.

HIT THE MUSCLES MOST BANDS MISS. Leg Cords are built to target the inner and outer thighs, front and rear glutes — the stabilisers that carry over directly to running, sport, and daily life. Train them standing: lateral band walks, side kicks, donkey kicks, glute kickbacks, hip abductions. Train them on the ground: clamshells, fire hydrants, lying leg raises. Add them to squats and lunges for resistance that doesn't quit at the bottom of the rep.

SMOOTH STRAPS. NO DRAMA. No skin pinching. No leg-hair waxing mid-set. Just smooth, heavy-duty tubing that holds up to daily training without babying.

NOT SURE WHERE TO START? The Yellow + Green bundle is the perfect entry point. Yellow for warm-ups and footwork drills, Green for regular training. Together they cover everything from activation work to full-resistance lower body sessions. Step up to the full 5-pack to get the complete tension range and progress all the way to Black Sniper when you're ready.

Want to round out your lower body setup? The Glute Loop handles thigh and hip activation work when you want a traditional loop band that stays put. The Soft Glute Bench pairs perfectly for hip thrusts and floor work. And if you're training with The Human Trainer Bodyweight Suspension System or Ripcords, Leg Cords round out the full ankle-to-shoulder resistance system — everything in one bag.

Every Leg Cord is backed by a LIFETIME REPLACEMENT WARRANTY and a 90-DAY SATISFACTION GUARANTEE for home use. Need a replacement within 90 days? We cover it — product and shipping. After 90 days, pay shipping only.

90 day warranty coverage for commercial use. Train hard. We've got the rest.

products.title: Ultimate Backyard Training Bundle
products.body_html:
Fresh air. Real dirt under your shoes. Zero wait for the squat rack. Outdoor training just hits different, and that's not just the vitamin D talking (although, also that).

Turns out your backyard can absolutely be a real gym. Research consistently links outdoor workout sessions to a bigger drop in tension, anger, and stress than the same session done indoors. Same gains. Better mood. No membership required.

The Backyard Gym Bundle packs six purpose-built tools into one order, and together they cover strength, conditioning, power, mobility, and cardio without a single machine or an ounce of wall space:

  • Kettlebell - Swings, goblet squats, cleans, presses, Turkish get-ups. The most versatile single piece of equipment in the bundle.
  • Fitness Sandbag - Carries, shouldering, deadlifts, squats. The shifting load recruits stabilizers a barbell never touches.
  • Weighted Vest - Strap it on and everything gets harder. Pull-ups, push-ups, runs, carries — same movement, more resistance, zero equipment changes.
  • Slam Ball - Power, aggression, and conditioning in one piece of rubber. Slam it into the grass as hard as you want. It can take it.
  • Jump Rope - The most underrated conditioning tool in any gym. Three minutes of jump rope will remind you of that fast.
  • Glute Loop - Activation, mobility, and accessory work. Warm up, cool down, or add resistance to bodyweight movements.

Nobody trains at the same level, so the kettlebell, sandbag, and slam ball each come in multiple weight options. Pick what suits you now. Add weight later without buying a whole new bundle.

10% OFF VERSUS BUYING SEPARATELY. Same gear, same quality, just less damage to the wallet. The math is simple: six individually would cost more. The bundle doesn't.

And because gear without a plan just collects dew: every bundle comes with the Backyard Gym training program FREE in the B.o.S. app. Built specifically around these six tools. No substitutions, no guesswork, no standing in the yard wondering what's next.

We picked these six because together they cover the most ground for outdoor gym training, full stop.Step outside, unroll the mat (or don't — grass works fine), and get those gains, al fresco.

Need something that moves instead of mounts? The Bumper Plate Weight Tree & Bar Holder rolls on lockable casters and holds four barbells too. Want fully modular and endlessly expandable? The Hydra Bumper Plate Tree Builder grows with your collection. LIMITED LIFETIME warranty on the frame and welds. Pick your width. Bolt it down. Stop tripping over bumper plates.

products.title: Cable Accessory Bundle
products.body_html:
If your cable machine is the meat and potatoes of your gym, this bundle is the full steakhouse upgrade.

These Cable Attachment Bundles (Beginner & Advanced) give you a complete lineup of handles and attachments to unlock more exercises, improve comfort, and actually use your cable machine to its full potential — all while saving you a solid chunk of change compared to buying everything individually.

And yes — they’re carabiner compatible, so you can clip them onto virtually any cable machine (not just ours) and swap between attachments in seconds.

Here’s what you’re working with:

Beginner Setup
→ Aluminum Handles (Adjustable) – lightweight, durable neutral grips with smooth rotation for fluid reps and happier wrists. Adjustable length lets you dial in curls, raises, and flies on any cable machine.
→ Tricep Rope Extension – your go-to for pushdowns, overhead extensions, and core work. Smooth movement, easy on the elbows, and always earns its keep.
→ Revolving Lat Pulldown Bar (with Safety Ends) – built for pulldowns and rows with smooth rotation and added safety stops to keep your grip locked in.
→ 20” Straight Bar – curls, pushdowns, upright rows — if it’s a cable classic, this bar handles it.
→ Adjustable Ankle Strap – because skipping leg day isn’t an option. Perfect for kickbacks, curls, and hip work.

Advanced Setup
→ Aluminum Handles with Bearings – upgraded grips with smooth rotation for better feel and less wrist strain. Once you try these, it’s hard to go back.
→ Extra Long Tricep Rope Extension – more length means deeper stretch and stronger contractions. Your triceps will notice.
→ 30” D-Handle Bar – wider grip for pulldowns and rows, helping you hit your back from angles you didn’t know you were missing.
→ Multi-Grip Curl Bar Attachment – angled grips for more comfortable curls and pushdowns. Your elbows will thank you.
→ Double D Handle – tight, controlled rows and pulldowns with serious back engagement. Small attachment, big impact.

Together, these attachments turn your cable machine from “nice to have” into “why didn’t I do this sooner.” You’ll add variety, improve movement quality, and get more out of every rep — without needing more machines or more space.

Beginner or Advanced, you’re getting a setup that just works — and works with almost any cable machine out there.
More attachments. More exercises. One bundle discount that makes way too much sense.

Clip in. Train smarter. And finally get your cable machine pulling its weight.

products.title: ABsyidyan Stainless Steel Ab Roller

Most ab wheels wobble, flex, and occasionally remind you what your carpet tastes like.

The ABsyidyan Stainless Steel Ab Roller is built on a simple idea: your ab wheel shouldn’t be the weakest thing in your gym. STAINLESS STEEL SHAFT. EXTRA-WIDE DUAL WHEEL. 500+ LB CAPACITY.

No plastic axles. No wobbly single wheels. Just a rock-solid roller that keeps up when things get hard.

The extra-wide dual latex-free rubber wheel gives you a stable base on any surface—hardwood, rubber, tile, or carpet—while the non-slip tread keeps you tracking straight.

Smooth mechanics mean quiet rollouts, so early mornings stay low-key. Grippy, ergonomic handles lock you in for high-rep sets without tearing up your hands.

No gimmicks. No compromises. Just a tool that works as hard as you do.

products.title: Basilisk Stack Loaded Leg Extension / Leg Curl
products.body_html:
If you’re here, you’re above the whole “skipping leg day” thing. A dedicated leg machine? No shortcuts. Big respect. A dedicated leg machine with a 310 LB stack and a strength curve we obsessed over for years? Now we’re talking.

Most leg extension/curl combos in this class tap out around 250 lbs. The Basilisk gives you 210 or 310 — your call. Just getting started? Go 210. Planning to build Quads of the Gods? Go 310. And if you outgrow the 210, there's a 100 LB upgrade kit with your name on it (figuratively).

But let’s be honest — the stack number isn’t the magic. The strength curve is.

We didn’t just slap a cam on and call it a day. We fine-tuned the geometry and pivot points so extensions and curls feel right. Smooth where they should be. Challenging where they need to be. No weird dead spots. No “why does this feel off?” moments. Just clean resistance the whole way through.

That 40% slope on the seat? Not random. It’s the sweet spot.

We tested, we did the math (well...paid someone to). It puts your hip flexors where they need to be for quad isolation, and lines up your hamstrings properly for curls. We tested it. A lot. Probably more than we should admit. The result: it works.

Fit-wise, we’ve got you covered.The back pad adjusts. Seat and leg positions adjust enough to fit lifters from 5'3" to 6'2" without feeling like a compromise. The leg holder gets out of your way when you need it to. And the stack can go left or right — because your gym layout should adjust to you. Not the other way around.

Now let’s talk durability.

Aluminum pulleys. TPU cable. Not sexy… until your machine doesn’t jam mid-set.

Cheap machines bind. Cables wear out. That’s exactly why we built the Basilisk the way we did — smoother operation, longer lifespan, and backed by our no-nonsense warranty.

We also kept the height low — on purpose.

Tall machines waste vertical space. The Basilisk fits where commercial units won’t, which makes it just as at home in a garage as it is on a gym floor. And if you are running a facility, we’ve got custom logo plates and 60mm attachment compatibility ready to go.

End result?

You’re getting a machine that goes toe-to-toe with competitor options, only they charge $1,000–$2,000 more. Same features. Same performance.

The only real difference? The logo.

And we don’t charge extra for that.

products.body_html:
Unlock hundreds of cable and barbell exercises within a single footprint with the All-in-One Trainer! This unit combines the cable versatility of a functional trainer with the barbell functionality of a squat stand in a space-conscious footprint.

The x-style frame and built-in storage make it an efficient use of floor space in the corner of your home gym. Or your living lifting room.

The two side cables feature a 2:1 pull ratio, making them great for lighter isolations like curls, tricep pushdowns, and chest flies. Meanwhile, the centre cables feature a 1:1 pull ratio — excellent for heavy back work like lat pulldowns & low rows.

The 2.3" x 2.3" (60mm x 60mm) uprights with 5/8" holes double as a squat stand, just add some j-cups and rock your barbell training on the same machine! Plus, they're also compatible with rack attachments — Y-Dip, Seal Row Pad, and more! 

Snag the beefy 210lb weight stack for the peak of convenience. Or grab the plate-loaded version if money is tight; you can transform it into a Weight Stack machine using the Upgrade Kit if you get tired of fumbling with plates.

Both units include two nylon handles, a lat pulldown bar, and a short straight bar.

IMPORTANT: The All-In-One Trainer MUST be bolted down to ensure the user and equipment's safety. Mounting hardware is not included, but we recommend Tapcon+ screws. Ships unassembled.

products.title: Multi-Purpose Olympic Barbell – The Utility Bar
products.body_html:
As a generalist bar, The Utility Bar is designed for people who don't adhere to a particular strength sport and just love an excellent bar.

With a 28.5mm diameter, it's just a tad thicker than an Olympic weightlifting bar (28mm diameter) and a smidge thinner than a powerlifting bar (29mm diameter). Brass bushings and no bearings make for a smooth rotation and an ultra-secure snap ring is used to keep it all together.

A medium-light knurl won't chew your hands up when power cleaning, but it's complemented with centre knurling for a better grip when squatting. Featuring both weightlifting and powerlifting marks, hand positioning is made easy for whatever movement you're doing that day. Lightly ribbed sleeves help keep your weight plates from shifting during your workouts.

Got smaller hands? You'll love the 25mm shaft & 15kg weight of the Juno Bar - Women's Utility Barbell.

IMPORTANT: For cerakote-coated barbells, added care should be used to avoid abrasive metal-to-metal contact. Tight-fitting collars, weight plates, un-lined landmine attachments and j-cups, etc - these can potentially cut into or wear off the cerakote finish. Taking these extra precautions will preserve that beautiful rust-resistant finish for years to come!

products.title: Manticore Four Post Converter Bench
products.body_html:
The four-post bench station is what you see at powerlifting meets and serious commercial gyms. It’s a dedicated bench press station, made your way when you add your favourite safeties and j-cups — and the Converter Bench makes it happen.

What makes this one different from the competition is the floating bench design.

The Converter Bench hangs between the specialty crossmembers with ZERO POSTS UNDERNEATH. That means you can tuck your feet back as far as you want without hitting anything. For powerlifters who rely on leg drive, this is a big deal.

Add your choice of roller J-cups, sandwich J-cups, regular J-cups, and safeties — spec this station out however you want. For more versatility, grab 4 Manticore Mag Pins (Full Length), so when you’re done benching, you can pop the pins, wheel the bench out, and use the uprights for other attachments. Dips. Seal rows. Whatever.

60" Manticore uprights built with the 3”x3” and 1" hole cross-brand compatibility you know and love (or hate, if you work for a competitor.) Looking for 5/8" holes? We make a 60" Hydra version, too. Either way, you’re getting IPF competition height and a four-post station that’s more versatile than anything else on the market.

This setup includes the Converter Bench and a pair of specialty 43" crossmembers (also available separately). Choose your j-cups and safeties to seal the deal. It’s also compatible with the spotter deck we’re developing so your favourite hander-offer (technical term) can get in on the action.

products.title: Manticore Two Post Converter Bench
products.body_html:
Remember the bench station at the gym you grew up going to? Two posts, open front, clean and simple. This is that, but better.

The two-post setup uses one pair of 60" uprights at the back and the Converter Bench’s own front foot on the other end. Front foot stabilizers keep everything locked in place with built-in bar storage for more value. Add the j-cups and spotter arms of your choice for safe solo training that the old commercial gym benches never had.

It’s less expensive than the four-post setup but gives you the same dedicated bench station experience. IPF height is maintained (because we engineered the crossmember holes and front foot height to line up perfectly), and you still get full access to all Hydra and Manticore attachments on the uprights.

When you’re done pressing, the front foot stabilizers double as bar storage. And if you need the uprights for something else, wheel the bench out in seconds.

products.title: Half Rack Conversion Kits
products.body_html:
Your squat stand was a great first date. This is the glow-up.

The Squat Stand to Half Rack Conversion Kit upgrades your setup with rear uprights and crossmembers—giving you more stability, more storage, and way more ways to train, without eating up extra space.

Re-racking heavy lifts feels more solid. Attachments hit different. And your rack? Way less “minimalist,” way more “do-it-all.”

Load it up with plate storage, add cables, run bands, or train front and back at the same time. The Hydra ecosystem is built to grow with you—so you’re never boxed in.

Why replace the whole rack when you can just… make it better?

Like all Hydra and Manticore gear, this upgrade is fully modular. Today it’s a half rack. Tomorrow, who knows—full rack, cable tower, lifting empire.

Built from 3” x 3”, 11-gauge steel with 5/8” to 1" holes (depending on your mythical beast rack of choice), it plays nice with a massive range of attachments.

Built like a tank (because it is). Same heavy-duty steel, same durable powder coat, same confidence under heavy weight.

products.title: Crossmember For Converter Bench - 43"
products.body_html:
This is the specialty crossmember that makes the four-post and two-post Converter Bench stations possible.

It’s a 43" crossmember with extra-large brackets and dual hole patterns — Manticore holes on the crossmember (to match the Converter Bench brackets) and oversized bracket holes that fit both Hydra and Manticore uprights.

Use one crossmember in your rack for an open, two post style set-up that works with any rack (paired with the Converter Bench’s front foot for stability). Or use two for a floating bench setup (only compatible with 24" depth racks).

This keeps the bench centred and at IPF competition height in every configuration.

products.title: Converter Bench - Flat Bench
products.body_html:
The Converter Bench isn’t a one-trick setup. It’s a modular system—build it how you want, change it when you need.

Run it as a standalone flat bench. A makeshift incline bench. Set it up as a four-post bench station or two-post bench station. Drop it into your Manticore or Hydra rack (or one of our competitors with matching 3” x 3” upright specs) with the optional 43" specialty crossmember. Or pair it with our upcoming combo rack for a full competition setup.

One bench, multiple configurations—no compromises.

And here’s where it gets serious: every setup maintains IPF competition height.

Doesn’t matter if it’s on its own feet, mounted to 60" Hydra or Manticore uprights, or locked into the combo rack—the height stays consistent. That wasn’t an accident. IPF specs are tight, and hitting them across multiple configurations (with different upright spacings) took real engineering work.

Also, this bad boy is a tank. Thick gauge steel. Competition-style padding. UHMW lining underneath so it doesn’t chew up your rack. The front foot is a single-post design that angles out for stability—while leaving room for lifters who like to tuck their feet back and actually use their leg drive. Want an incline without another bench? For more versatility, grab 2 Manticore Mag Pins (Full Length), so you can pop the pins, remove the front foot, and unlock a 27.6° setup. Simple.

Grab just the pad and frame if you’re integrating it into a rack or combo setup. Or go with the full version with removable feet for standalone use, or if you’re a little fickle and want to change it up now and then. Wheels and a handle make it easy to move—because heavy doesn’t have to mean stuck.

This is for powerlifters and serious home gym owners who want one bench that adapts with them. The flat bench hasn’t changed in years.

We figured it should.

IMPORTANT: 43" Specialty Crossmember required to drop the Converter Bench into a rack. Mounting brackets are spaced to fit 24" depth for floating bench configuration (no feet).

products.title: Cable Tower Squat Stands
products.body_html:
Your home gym doesn't need another machine taking up half the floor. It needs one piece that does the work of two.

The Cable Tower Squat Stand is TWO independent cable towers connected by a pull-up bar, with J-cups ready to drop in so you're benching or squatting in the same session you're doing face pulls. One unit. Hundreds of exercises. Zero redundancy.

TWO RESISTANCE OPTIONS. ONE STANDARD.

products.title: Cable Tower
products.body_html:
Overview

The Bells of Steel Cable Tower delivers full cable-machine functionality in a compact footprint under 2.5' × 2.5'—making it one of the most space-efficient cable systems available. With 30+ height settings, dual pull ratios (2:1 and 1:1), and your choice of plate-loaded, 110 lb or 210 lb selectorized stack, it's designed to give you commercial-level versatility without the size or cost of traditional cable machines.

Why a Cable Tower Belongs in Your Gym

Cable machines are one of the most versatile pieces of strength equipment you can own. Unlike fixed-path machines or barbells alone, cable systems allow for constant tension, free movement patterns, and joint-friendly resistance.

The Cable Tower brings these benefits into a format designed specifically for home gyms—where space, flexibility, and value matter most.

Whether you're training for strength, hypertrophy, rehab, or general fitness, a cable tower unlocks movements that are difficult or impossible to replicate with free weights alone.

Built for Real Home Gym Constraints

Many cable machines are designed for commercial gyms—large, heavy, and space-intensive. That's not practical for most home setups.

The Bells of Steel Cable Tower is engineered differently.

  • Compact footprint (~2.5' × 2.5') fits in tight spaces
  • Multiple mounting options (rack, wall, or floor) adapt to your layout
  • Low-profile design works in basements and garages. Instead of designing your gym around the machine, this machine fits into your gym.
  • 110 lb mini stack option lets you pay for what you need, rather than paying for weight you won't use.


Precision Adjustability

One of the biggest limitations of many cable machines is limited adjustability. Fewer height settings mean compromised angles, awkward positioning, and less effective movements.

With 30+ clearly numbered height settings, the Cable Tower allows you to:

  • Dial in precise joint angles
  • Maintain consistent setup between sessions
  • Perform a wider range of exercises correctly

This level of adjustability is typically found in higher-end commercial machines, but rarely in compact home gym towers.

Who It's For

Beginners
Smooth resistance, lighter loading options, and adjustable angles make it easy to learn proper form safely.

Intermediate Lifters
Supports structured programming with consistent setups and a wide range of accessory movements.

Advanced Athletes
1:1 heavy pulls, precise angles, and upgrade options make it ideal for targeted strength and hypertrophy work.

Small-Space Home Gym Owners
Perfect for garages, basements, apartments, and multi-use rooms thanks to its compact footprint.

Coaches & Trainers
Delivers the versatility of multiple cable machines without requiring the space or cost of a full commercial setup.

Designed to Grow With Your Gym

The Cable Tower isn't a one-dimensional machine—it's a foundation piece.

  • Compatible with standard cable attachments
  • Works alongside rack attachments and accessories
  • Supports progression from beginner to advanced training

As your training evolves, the Cable Tower adapts with you—so you won't outgrow it.

Choose the Right Loading Style

Selectorized Mini Weight Stack (110 lb)

  • Economical without sacrificing functionality
  • Benefits of 210 lb stack without the cost
  • Ideal for new lifters

Selectorized Weight Stack (210 lb)

  • Fast, convenient pin adjustments
  • Ideal for circuits, supersets, and shared use
  • Clean and efficient workflow

Plate-Loaded Version

  • Unlimited loading potential
  • Lower upfront cost
  • Ideal for users who already own plates

All options use the same core system, footprint, and adjustability—so your choice comes down to preference, not limitations.

Exercise Variety

Upper Body

  • Lat pulldown
  • Seated cable row
  • Face pull
  • Triceps pushdown
  • Cable curl
  • Chest fly (high, mid, low)
  • Lateral raise
  • Straight-arm pulldown

Lower Body

  • Cable pull-through
  • Romanian deadlift
  • Split squat
  • Glute kickback
  • Cable hamstring curl
  • Hip abduction/adduction

Core

  • Cable crunch
  • Pallof press
  • Woodchopper (high-to-low / low-to-high)
  • Anti-rotation holds

Functional / Athletic

  • Cable punches
  • Rotational presses
  • Resistance walkouts

This versatility is why many lifters consider a cable tower one of the most-used pieces in their gym.

Dual Pull Ratios

Not all cable systems feel the same—and pull ratio plays a huge role in how they perform.

The Cable Tower gives you both:

  • 2:1 Ratio → smoother, lighter resistance for accessory work
  • 1:1 Ratio (with adapter) → full resistance for heavy lifts

This means you can move seamlessly between high-rep accessory work, isolation movements, and heavy strength-focused exercises. Instead of needing multiple machines, you get a full spectrum of resistance in one system.

Smooth Cable Feel

A cable machine is only as good as how it feels during use.

The Cable Tower is designed to deliver smooth pulley rotation, consistent cable tension, and minimal friction during movement. Combined with its rigid frame (when properly mounted), this creates a training experience users often describe as "commercial-feel" in a home gym setup.

For those looking to further refine performance, optional upgrades (like aluminum pulleys) can enhance smoothness even more.

products.title: Bells of Steel Training App
products.body_html:
You bought the equipment. Now let's make sure it doesn't become an expensive coat rack.

I'm Kaevon, founder of Bells of Steel — and I built this app for one simple reason: I kept seeing customers trying to shove their home gym into programs that weren't built for it. 'Yeah, I'm following this program — I'm just trying to shoehorn my home gym setup into it.' I hated that.

If we're selling equipment, we should be teaching people how to use it — with training that actually matches what we sell.

Then there was the second reason (and it hit home hard): I'm a parent and a busy professional. Most training falls into two buckets: (1) hardcore programs I used to do in my 20s when I had two hours a day — that's not real life anymore. (2) AI generators that sound advanced but ignore basic strength principles.

My wife selected 'Maximum Strength' in a popular app. It responded with weeks starting with high-rep lunges — and at one point prescribed heavier bicep curls than bench press. That's nonsensical programming even a junior strength coach would never do.

If strength is the goal, the structure should reflect that: heavy compounds first, logical progressions, rep ranges that make sense.

Meanwhile, our customers are busy parents, comeback lifters, and professionals saying: 'I got a home gym because I don't have time to drive to the gym. I want something simple, effective, consistent — I can just trust a professional is looking out for me. I'm not trying to bench 300 again. I just want to feel strong, move better, and not get hurt.'

That's what this app is built for.

We built it on professional coaching software used by thousands of coaches worldwide — elite-level tracking, performance reports, and a massive demo library baked in. Not a flimsy checklist platform.

If you want the simplest way to use your home gym and actually progress week to week? Welcome. Let the gainz begin.

— Kaevon, Founder, Bells of Steel

Our gym is in our living room. Our kids grow up watching us train. They see consistency. They see discipline. They see mom and dad getting stronger together.

That's why we offer a Couples plan. Because strength is better when it's shared.

Two people. Two programs. One stronger household.

products.title: Deadlift Bar
products.body_html:
The Bells of Steel Deadlift Bar has one job: help you yank ungodly weight off the floor, and then come back for more.

Unlike a traditional 29mm power bar designed to handle squats, bench press, and deadlifts, this 27mm deadlift-specific bar is longer and intentionally “whippier,” allowing the shaft to flex before the plates fully break from the ground.

That flex isn’t a gimmick; it raises your starting position slightly, lets you engage your hips and posterior chain before the full load hits, and helps experienced lifters ramp into heavy weight instead of getting crushed by it all at once.

The thinner diameter can also improve grip feel, while the absence of a center knurl saves your shins during aggressive pulls.

Deadlift bars are commonly used in strongman competitions and many powerlifting federations.

The deadlift bar is a specialty performance upgrade for lifters who already know the deadlift is their money lift.

Chasing PRs? Training for strongman? Stepping on the platform? Or just emotionally attached to loading more plates than your friends?

Good. This deadlift bar is for you.

products.title: Open Trap Bar / Hex Bar
products.body_html:
Overview

The Bells of Steel Open Trap Bar is a highly versatile strength-training tool engineered for deadlifts, rows, carries, lunges, squats, RDLs, presses, and dozens of accessory movements—without beating up your back in the process.

Its open design, integrated deadlift jack, dual handle heights with neutral grip placement, compact and stable build make it easier to use, easier to load, and easier to control than traditional hex bars. Built from high-strength steel with fully knurled handles, it delivers premium quality and performance at a home-gym-friendly price — offering unmatched value compared to competitors' alternatives.

Whether you're brand new, chasing PRs, or getting back under the bar after a "life happened" phase, this bar is a must-have tool in your training arsenal.

Why Choose an Open Trap Bar?

Open trap bars have become the modern standard because they solve problems older hex bars can't:

  • Improved movement freedom (lunges, rows, carries, split squats)
  • Safer mechanics for beginners learning hinge patterns
  • Easier loading due to the built-in jack designs
  • Better ergonomics for tall, long-limbed, or mobility-limited lifters
  • Full-body use instead of just deadlifts

The BOS Open Trap Bar takes all of these advantages and delivers them with balanced geometry, premium knurling, and durability — without the inflated price tag.

Who It's For

Beginners
The high handles, stable frame, and balanced center-mass make learning the deadlift safer and more controlled. Beginners also benefit from the open design for lunges and split squats.

Intermediate Lifters
Switch quickly between lifts using the dual-handle setup and easy loading. Ideal for accessory work programmed between barbell lifts.

Advanced Lifters & Strength Athletes
Rated for 700 lbs with knurled handles and a rigid frame designed for maximal pulls. Perfect for heavy deadlifts, RDLs, shrugs, and loaded carries.

Small-Space & Garage Gym Users
A single tool that replaces multiple specialty training tools without requiring extra storage space. The open design gives you more movement variety in tight spaces.

Coaches, Trainers & Home-Gym Power Users
One bar supports hinge mechanics, bilateral work, rows, carries, gait patterns, and accessory-strength programming for a wide range of clients.

Ease of Use

Built-In Deadlift Jack
Tilt the bar onto its feet, and slide plates on effortlessly. This drastically reduces setup fatigue and keeps the bar stable while loading heavy weights.

Easy to Maneuver
The open design reduces awkwardness during movement transitions. The centered load path makes every movement feel smoother and more predictable.

Beginner-Friendly Learning Curve
High handles + stable frame + good knurl = ideal for teaching hinge mechanics or returning to pulling after injury.

Value & Cost Efficiency

Buying separate bars for deadlifts, farmer carries, rows, and split squats quickly becomes expensive. The Open Trap Bar replaces:

  • Hex bar
  • Carry handles
  • Row bar
  • Farmer carry implements
  • Multiple specialty attachments
Durability & Longevity

Premium Build Quality
This bar is engineered to endure years of high-volume training cycles. Welds are strong, sleeves spin smoothly, and the frame is built to maintain alignment under repeated loading.

Improved Packaging
Updated packaging protects your bar during transport, so it arrives shiny and new—the way it should.

Low-Maintenance Finish
Simply wipe down between sessions to resist moisture and sweat buildup.

Engineering & Construction

Balanced, Stable Geometry
The bar's centerline is engineered for balance, reducing forward roll and side-to-side wobble during carries, rows, and heavy pulls. Multiple reviewers specifically highlight how unexpectedly balanced the bar feels compared to cheaper models.

High-Strength Steel Frame
Built from rigid steel designed to stay stable under load. The bar is rated to 700 lbs and maintains its shape even during heavy deadlifts.

Dual Handle Heights
Low handles replicate the standard barbell pulling height, while high handles offer reduced range of motion, easier setup for beginners, and safer pulls for lifters with mobility limitations.

Fully Knurled Handles
Both handle sets are knurled end-to-end for a consistent, confident grip without being overly aggressive. Reviewers frequently call out the knurling as one of the standout features.

Durable, Protective Finish
A reinforced coating helps limit chips, scuffs, and wear from daily use. Improved packaging helps prevent dents and dings during transport.

Sleeves for Standard Plates
Compatible with Olympic-style plates (50 mm sleeves), including bumper plates, steel plates, and change plates.

Full-Body Versatility

Unlike closed hex bars that feel "locked in," the open side unlocks dozens of movements:

Lower Body

  • Deadlifts
  • RDLs
  • Squats & squat variations
  • Lunges & reverse lunges
  • Split squats
  • Step-ups
  • Trap-bar jumps

Upper Body

  • Seal rows
  • Bent-over rows
  • Press-outs
  • Iso holds

Loaded Conditioning

  • Farmer carries
  • Suitcase carries
  • Marches & gait patterns
  • Strongman-style conditioning circuits

The open design dramatically increases the training value of a single bar — making this one of the most cost-efficient specialty bars you can own.

Recommended Set-Ups:
- The 70” shelves are ideal for roomy home gyms. They work great in a standalone Hydra Storage System, or as extra long “wings” of off-rack storage for an extensive fleet of dumbbells and kettlebells.
- The 43” shelves are excellent in a standalone unit, as off-rack storage “wings” for a partial dumbbell set (5-50lb), or mounted inside the storage area of a six-post rack — with the front uprights still usable.
- The 30” shelves are best suited for smaller free weight sets and best used in a standalone storage unit for a dead-space zone, such as the corner of your gym or between two doors in a garage.

products.body_html:
These adjustable shelf dividers are designed to work seamlessly with both our dumbbell/kettlebell shelves and bumper plate/med ball shelves.

Unlike fixed-slot dividers that lock you into rigid spacing, these dividers clamp on securely wherever you want them, giving you total control over your storage layout.

products.title: Rack Junctions - 3" x 3"
products.body_html:
The Bells of Steel Rack Junctions let you connect, expand, and customize your rack setup any way you want. Attach a Kraken cable tower, extend a pull-up bar, or build a custom storage rig. The only limit is your imagination!

There are two versions:

  • Box Junctions: Compact 3x3 uprights with keyholes on all sides. Perfect for top or side connections.
  • Stand Junctions: Taller units with a built-in footplate for added stability and creative setups.

Each junction features right-side-up and upside-down keyholes so you can bolt and rotate them in any direction. It’s a clever bit of over-engineering that gives you near-infinite configuration options. Our engineers don't sleep!

Instead of paying to ship a pair of full uprights, these junctions give you the same rock-solid strength in a smaller, cheaper, easier-to-handle package. They’re compact, cost-effective, and built to last.

Compatible with Hydra and Manticore systems, the Rack Junctions are your ticket to a smarter, more flexible home gym setup. Whether you’re connecting a Kraken, expanding your pull-up station, or building out storage, these are the missing pieces your setup’s been waiting for.

Our Favourite Junction Recipes:

Kraken Batwing Attachment Setup:

  • 1 x Kraken 
  • 1 Box Junction
  • 1 Stand Junctions
  • 1 x Upright to match your rack setup (minimum 84")
  • 4 crossmembers (we recommend 2 x 30"+ for barbell and loading clearance to connect to your power rack, 2 x 24" minimum to house the Kraken.

Extended Pull-Up Bar:

  • 2 Stand Junctions
  • 1 pull-up bar to match your rack width

Wheeling storage:

  • 2 stand junctions
  • 2 x 30" Hydra flatfoot crossmembers
  • 1 x 43" crossmember
  • 1 x caster wheels (set of 4)
  • 4 x vertical barbell holders for flat foot

Need a hand customizing your setup? Contact our ever-so-helpful Customer Support team. Have a new recipe to share? Tag us on Instagram.

products.title: Die-Cut Sticker Upgrade / Sticker Pack
products.body_html:
Show off your pride with our 3-pack of die-cut stickers, the ultimate way to rep your Bells of Steel style on literally anything that’ll hold still long enough.

You’ll get:
  • The Classic Logo: For the loyalists who bleed B.o.S. (and probably protein powder).
  • The Crowned Weight Plate: Because your barbell deserves a royal court.
  • The Rise & Grind: Perfect for those 5AM lifters who think rest days are for the weak (you're like, really tough.)
Do they improve PRs? We don’t have any evidence that they don’t...

Stick ‘em on your gym bottle, laptop, or car bumper to let the world know your entire personality is, in fact, lifting heavy things and putting them back down.

products.title: Flat-Iron Tricep Press Cable Attachment
products.body_html:
Meet the Flat Iron Tricep Press Bar: the carabiner compatible cable attachment that forces perfect form, isolates your triceps, and tells wrist and elbow pain to take a hike.

Instead of gripping and ripping, you press with your palms. That means max tricep activation with zero strain. Beginners love how easy it makes finding their triceps, and advanced lifters dig the variety it adds to their cable lineup.

It’s not just for pressdowns, either; smash out curls and pullovers, too. Pick the 16.5" bar for focused tricep work or the 25.5" bar for wider grips and more exercise options. Both are built from 6.5mm steel, tough enough to outlast your gym excuses.

Cleaner form. Better activation. Less pain. More gains.

IMPORTANT: Attaches to any cable machine with carabiner. Carabiner not included.

products.title: Footplate for Cable Tower/All In One Trainer
products.body_html:
Sick of bracing your feet on a skinny beam mid–lat pulldown? Enter the Bells of Steel Footplate for Cable Towers & All In One Trainers: a simple, sturdy add-on that fixes one of the most annoying cable tower quirks.

No bolts, no assembly, no fuss. Just pop it out of the box, set it in place, and once your feet are planted, it stays locked down tighter than your lifting belt on PR day. Small upgrade, BIG difference in comfort and stability.
This grippy checkerboard steel plate slides right onto your Bells of Steel 2.3” x 2.3” (60mm) setup: Cable Tower, All-in-One Trainer, or Power Rack. UHMW lining protects your investment.

products.title: Legacy Leg Extension / Hamstring Curl Machine - Plate Loaded
products.body_html:
The Legacy Leg Extension & Curl Machine delivers full-range leg training with a patent-pending toggle for no dead zone, prone hamstring curls, and a preacher curl attachment add-on.

  • Patent-Pending Toggle → Innovative design delivers a full range of motion resistance with no dead zone, for the deepest stretch and best muscle activation possible.
  • Multi-Purpose Design → Switch seamlessly between leg extensions and prone or seated hamstring curls on one compact, plate-loaded machine.
  • Preacher Curl Attachment (Optional) → Expands your training beyond leg day with targeted biceps work. Carabiner-compatible so you can use your favourite cable handle (not included) for a personalized setup.
  • Elite Adjustability → Customize your setup with five adjustment points, six seat angles, and six back pad angles, this leg extension machine for home gym setups dials in for your body type and exercise. Tall? Short? Somewhere in between? We’ve got you.
  • Built to Last → Constructed from heavy duty steel tubing for rock-solid stability and long-term durability.
  • Premium Comfort → Double-thick leg rollers and high-grade vinyl padding provide commercial-level comfort and support.
  • Smart Details → Numbered settings for repeatable setups, true 2" Olympic plate pegs with collars, and integrated storage ports for attachments and plates.
  • Safety-First Design → Includes toggle lockout, safety stopper, and optional bolt-down plate for secure solo training.
  • Best for → Small to large home gyms, bodybuilding and strength-focused training, rehab and functional athletes, and all experience levels.

 

What's Included:

  • Legacy Leg Extension & Hamstring Curl Machine – Main unit with patent-pending toggle system
  • Spring Collar – Keeps weight plates locked in place during training
  • Leg Holder - stay locked in for every rep
  • Assembly Hardware

Preacher curl attachment sold separately. Comes with lead chain and carabiner. Handle not included. Pair with your favourite handle for next-level versatility.

products.title: Pandemonium Squat – 3-in-1 Pendulum Squat / Calf Press / Viking Press Machine
products.body_html:
Meet the Pandemonium Squat: a 3-in-1 pendulum squat, viking press, and calf raise machine built to unleash multifunctional glory in your home gym.

  • Multifunctional Full-Body Work → Use it for pendulum squats, Viking presses, calf raises, dips, pull-ups, and even rows.
  • Adjustable for All Heights → Single tall upright with three peg levels accommodates shorter and taller lifters (up to ~6’5”).
  • Attachment Compatibility → Compatible with 2.3" x 2.3" (60mm) rack attachments for extra storage and versatility.
  • Counterbalance Arm → Offsets the weight of the lever for a smoother, more natural resistance curve.
  • Removable Back Pad → Easily detaches for quick transitions between exercises like squats, Viking presses, and rows — keeping your workouts efficient and your setup clutter-free.
  • Built to Last → Constructed from heavy-duty steel tubing for rock-solid stability and long-term durability.
  • Safety & Control → a guided lever arm and built-in spotter lets beginners and veterans alike push limits confidently.
  • Home-gym optimized footprint → Designed for residential use: smaller and more affordable than commercial pendulum squats.
  • Best for → medium to large home gyms, body builders, strength athletes, rehab athletes, all experience levels.

What's Included:

  • Counterbalance arm
  • 2× Plate storage pegs (for extra 45 lb plates)
  • Extender feet
  • Removable back pad with 2× magnetic pins
  • Viking press handlesSpotter arm for Viking press setup
  • Extra-long magnetic pin (for stabilizing the arm, pull-ups, and spotter arm use)
  • All assembly hardware: nuts, bolts, and everything you need to build it

products.title: 48KG Extension Kit for Adjustable Kettlebell - Wildman Poison Pill
products.body_html:
The best adjustable kettlebell just got better. Designed in collaboration with kettlebell mastermind Mark Wildman, this expansion transforms your existing 12–32kg Adjustable Kettlebell into a monstrous 12–48kg Adjustable Kettlebell Set. That’s right: over 100lbs in one kettlebell.

But fair warning: this bad boy isn’t for beginners or classes. It’s made for heavy hitters who’ve already tamed their current setup and are hungry for more. As you load more plates, the bell gets longer (yes, physically), making it less snatch-and-clean friendly, but perfect for grinds, swings, and farmer carries that’ll light your soul—and forearms—on fire.

Kettlebell not included—this is an expansion pack only!

What’s Included:

  • Four (4) × 4kg black powder-coated cast iron plates
  • Four (4) extender bolts (1 per increment level)
  • One (1) all-in-one wrench for torque-tightening wizardry
  • One (1) short bolt for 1-plate setups
  • One (1) extra nut


IMPORTANT: You MUST tighten the extension bolt before every use. This expansion pack is compatible with the 12–32kg Adjustable Kettlebell (Bells of Steel or Mark Wildman editions). It’s not compatible with the 6–12kg Adjustable Kettlebell or Plastic Bottom, and while it might fit other brands with similar molds, we can’t guarantee it. We do not recommend expansions for classes or quick transitions as changing weights takes 1-2 minutes.

products.title: StrongArm Combo Rack - Squat Stand & Bench Press
products.body_html:
Meet the StrongArm Combo Rack: a powerlifting-style squat and bench press combo rack built for lifters who want space-efficient competition-level performance at home.

Designed for heavy training and competition practice, this combo rack features adjustable uprights and an intuitive set up that lets you shift seamlessly from squats to bench in seconds.

The competition-width bench locks in tight for max stability, while safety arms keep you safe when you’re going for broke on a new PR.

Built from heavy-duty steel with precision machining, this combo rack gives you that meet-day feel right in your garage or basement gym (minus the judges glaring at you.) White lights, babyyyy!

products.title: 3x3 Cable Tower to Rack Connection Kit
products.body_html:
The Cable Tower to Rack Connection Kit is your ticket to a smarter, tighter setup. Designed to centre-mount your 3"x3" Oblivyon Cable Tower neatly to your Hydra or Manticore rack with a curved-slot bracket and connector piece that fit both hole patterns.

Reclaim that awkward “dead zone” behind your rack while keeping full clearance to squat, bench, and press inside your four-post fortress. The adjustable slot fits 80.5"–90" racks, letting you dial in a perfectly straight fit, so everything looks clean, works smoothly, and stays out of the way when you’re under the bar.

Why it rocks:

  • Space Efficient – Centre-mounting keeps your rack + tower compact without cramping your lifts.
  • Full Clearance – Still plenty of room to bench or squat inside a four-post rack.
  • Fine-Tuned Fit – Curved slot adjustment makes setup seamless, for your crossmember height.

Translation: a tighter footprint, more versatility, and zero excuses not to squat.

IMPORTANT: NOT compatible with 2.3" x 2.3" Cable Towers.

products.title: Rubber Flooring Gym Mat 24" x 24" (Set of 2)
products.body_html:
These rubber gym floor mats are the heavy-duty gym flooring solution your home setup’s been begging for.

These 24” x 24” recycled rubber tiles are the perfect blend of durability, flexibility, and don’t-make-this-harder-than-it-has-to-be simplicity. Each 2-pack includes 2 connector clips, so you can expand your gym flooring as your gain goals grow.

Perfect for:

- Building out a clean, professional-looking gym floor at home.

- Dropping heavy stuff without wrecking your floor — or your life.

- Those who like their rubber thick, low-odor, and lifts heavy.

products.title: Out of Spec KG Competition Bumper Plates
products.body_html:
Same great plates. Slightly off spec. BIG savings.

Our KG Competition Bumper Plates are tough as nails, built for heavy-duty training, and designed to take a beating. But this batch didn’t quite pass the “Olympic lifter with a magnifying glass” test.

Instead of the usual ultra-tight 0.1% weight tolerance, these beauties landed closer to 0.5%. That’s basically the difference between carrying a couple extra french fries in your bag.

For 99% of lifters, that margin is completely unnoticeable. But if you’re an elite competitor where every gram matters, these aren’t for you.

If you’re training at home, smashing PRs, and don’t mind saving some serious coin? Oh baby, this is your golden ticket.

IMPORTANT: Not IWF approved. The precision-cut 50.5mm center hole might not fit out-of-spec Olympic barbells.

products.title: Arch Nemesis Tricep Bar
products.body_html:
Your small gym just got a mighty upgrade: The Arch Nemesis Tricep Bar is like that freakishly handy multi-tool your dad won’t stop talking about: it’s a tricep bar, landmine handle, and cable attachment all in one gloriously grippy package.

You can use it for your favorite tricep bar exercises, but this isn’t just a bar for triceps! Throw it on your cable machine for lat pulldowns and seated rows or a landmine attachment for landmine rows and viking presses.

Plus, it’s compact, lightweight, and won’t hog space like its big bro (the original Arch Nemesis). Even better? It fits standard 2-inch barbell collars, so you won’t need to invest in weirdly sized clamps.With moderately knurled tubing and two grip options (angled wide + straight narrow), this bar delivers versatility without the wallet workout.

And at just 15.5lbs (7kgs), it’s easy to throw your new lil buddy around (please don’t).

Perfect for small spaces, cable towers, and anyone who loves exercise variety without buying four different bars.

Looking for something rackable or for dedicated swiss bar bench press work? Try the O.G. Arch Nemesis Swiss Bar instead.

products.title: LB Competition Bumper Plate Sets
products.body_html:
Wickedly precise and boldly coloured, the Competition Bumper Plates are the perfect calibrated plates for Olympic lifting.

These competition bumper plates don't just look amazing, they also closely align with IWF specs and outperform all-black bumpers.

While they're not IWF approved, they do check the key boxes: 450mm diameter, colour-coded, and guaranteed to +/- 0.1% of the claimed weight.

The galvanized centre hub with its co-molded steel collar won't spin or break from the rubber and uses an innovative method to securely lock the bolts in place.

All this mumbo-jumbo to say that the hub is safeguarded against loosening and the competition bumper plates will scuff less over time.

The thing is, they're made in pounds because, well, #freedomunits. If needed, grab the kilogram version here instead.

But don't let that rain on your parade, they still make excellent training plates for Olympic weightlifting!

Version 2.0: Compared to the previous version, these have no centre hub bolts and feature a traditional edge inside the plates, making them easier to grab.

IMPORTANT: Not IWF approved. The precision-cut 50.5mm centre hole might not fit out-of-spec Olympic barbells.

products.title: Belt Squat Machine
products.body_html:
Out-train back pain and upper body mobility limitations while building lower body strength. The Belt Squat Machine is space-efficient and versatile, unlocking endless exercises for your home gym at an unbeatable price.
Built like a tank, this beast boasts an impressive 700lb capacity (step aside, Hip Thrust Machine). Plus, its innovative design features commercial-grade Zerk bearings and band pegs for improving your lockout strength.

Despite its beastly strength, this strength machine is a gentle giant in your gym space. At a modest 51" x 81" footprint, it's already a surprisingly good fit — but here's the kicker: mount those weight pegs vertically, and you've instantly shrunk the footprint down to 51" x 52.5". That's nearly 30" of extra breathing room for more equipment, more exercises, or just more room to flex in the mirror.

IMPORTANT: The belt squat machine has 13 adjustable heights but is not guaranteed to allow all lifters to squat ATG (full depth). If you bottom out early, standing on stackable pull blocks or bumper plates or placing your machine on a DIY platform will give you the extra range of motion you need.

products.title: Oblivyon Tower - 3" x 3” Cable Tower Squat Stands
products.body_html:
If the Manticore Rack and Oblivyon Tower had a very beefy baby, this would be it.

The 3"x3" Cable Tower Squat Stands are a fusion of a cable crossover machine and squat rack, jammed into one overbuilt unit that still fits in your garage and allows for 100's of exercises. 

These dual adjustable cable towers are built with thick 3x3” chrome uprights that boast 4-way keyhole attachments and laser-cut numbering, so you can set your heights without guessing games.

Connected by a rugged Manticore pull-up bar for added strength, stability and pull-up gains.

Go for the plate-loaded version or the smooth weight stack with bonus weight horns for extra weight. Upgrading from plate loaded to stack is available if you change your mind in the future. 

Compatible with our Hydra and Manticore attachment lines, and even cross-brand friendly as they are true 3x3” uprights for the commitment-phobes out there.


Includes:

2 - Pairs of Aluminum Handles with Bearings

4 - Swivel Shackles

2 - 2-to-1 Adapter

4 - Carabiners

4- Top and bottom slot Brackets for mounting

1 - Manticore straight pull up bar

All Hardware for assembly

Back uprights are optional, but are strongly recommended when mounting to the floor for increased stability and are required for mounting the Smith machine Rack Attachment (which can only be mounted straight up and down).

IMPORTANT: Due to their small footprint and tall height, Cable Tower squat stand MUST be bolted to the floor or wall to ensure the user and equipment’s safety. Mounting hardware is not included — we recommend Tapcon+ screws. Ships unassembled.

Cable Tower Squat Stands are NOT compatible with Hydra pull-up bars or Hydra Landmine. They are compatible with 43" and 70" Manticore Straight Pull Up Bar and Manticore Multigrip Pull Up Bar. The Manticore Adjustable Pull Up Bar is compatible, but must be mounted on the front upright and will limit handle height on the towers.

products.title: Hydra Half Rack - Prebuilt (3" x 3", ⅝" Holes)

products.title: Adjustable Competition Kettlebell
products.body_html:
Overview

The Adjustable Competition Kettlebell is a precision-engineered strength tool designed for lifters who want the full weight range of an entire kettlebell set in one beautiful bell—without sacrificing space, feel, or durability. Talk about an overachiever.

Built with a steel shell, iron plates, 0.5 kg micro-loading, true competition shape and size, and up to 41 weight intervals in one bell, it delivers the exact performance of fixed kettlebells in a modular, space-saving format.

Unlike quick-adjust dial systems that rely on plastic components and age like milk, this bell prioritizes stability, longevity, and premium commercial-grade construction, making it the ideal choice for serious home gym owners, minimalist training spaces, and athletes who demand uncompromising performance, no matter what they (Turkish) get up to.

IMPORTANT: The Adjustable Kettlebell is a fantastic tool, but it is not recommended when a fast transition of sizes is needed since changing the weights takes 1-2 minutes. If you need two different weights for swings and overhead work, we recommend getting two adjustable kettlebells for sale — you save 10% when you buy a pair.

Who It's For

Beginners
Micro-loading and optional lighter-start add-ons make early progression smoother and safer. Perfect for learning kettlebell fundamentals with proper form.

Intermediate Lifters
41 weight settings enable continuous progression for full-body strength training. Switch between swings, cleans, presses, squats, and accessory work without needing multiple bells.

Advanced Athletes
True competition sizing, balanced geometry, and 0.5 kg precision jumps allow refined technique, double-bell programming, and plateau breaking—ideal for serious kettlebell practitioners.

Small-Space Home Gyms & Apartments
Replace an entire rack of kettlebells in the footprint of a single bell. Highly portable, compact, and quiet enough for multi-unit living.

Coaches & Personal Trainers
While not recommended for classes, the wide adjustability supports multiple clients with different strength levels using a single piece of equipment.

Premium Build & Materials

Every component is chosen for commercial durability:

  • Steel Shell: maintains perfect geometry across all weights
  • Iron Plates: machined to tight tolerances for consistent balance
  • Steel-on-Steel Locking System: no fragile plastic, no gimmicks
  • Competition Handle (35 mm): consistent grip feel at any load
  • Balanced Bell Cavity: ensures predictable swing paths and smooth transitions

The result is an adjustable system that feels indistinguishable from a fixed kettlebell—something customers repeatedly confirm in reviews.

Weight Range & Micro-Loading

With 41 possible weight settings from 12–32 kg, the Adjustable Competition Kettlebell gives you full control over your progression.

Why Micro-Loading Matters
Most adjustable kettlebells jump in 1–2 kg increments (or larger), forcing lifters into uncomfortable leaps. This bell offers 0.5 kg micro-loading, allowing:

  • Smoother strength progression
  • Safer jumps for beginners
  • More precise overload for advanced athletes
  • Fine-tuned programming for kettlebell complexes
  • Easier weight matching during unilateral accessory work

This is one of the product's biggest advantages over the competition.

Plastic Bottom Add-On: Lighter Weights, More Versatility

Many users require access to lighter ranges for curls, shoulder prehab, warm-ups, or accessory training. The Plastic Bottom Add-On solves this by reducing the bell to a 9 kg base, with plate configurations enabling 9.5–11.5 kg. Perfect for:

  • Single-arm curls
  • Preacher curls
  • Shoulder rehab/prehab
  • Beginners learning kettlebell technique
  • Accessory isolation movements

It essentially expands the product downward, offering a true full-range kettlebell system from 9–32 kg.

Stability & Internal Movement

Many competitor bells rattle and shake, creating instability and distraction during exercise. This bell minimizes shifting through:

  • Precision-cut iron plates
  • Tight internal fitment
  • A secure locking system
  • A stable cavity shape engineered to reduce noise

Most users describe the feel as "solid," "stable," and "built like a tank."

How It Compares to Other Adjustable Kettlebells
Feature Adjustable Competition KB Typical Adjustable KBs
Weight Range 12–32 kg (expandable to 9–32 kg w/ add-on) 16–24 kg or limited ranges
Increment Size 0.5 kg micro-loading 1–2 kg jumps or fixed stops
Construction All-metal steel + iron Often uses plastic components
Geometry True competition standards Varies; many non-standard shapes
Adjustment System Secure steel-on-steel, durable Fast-but-fragile dial systems
Feel During Use Matches fixed kettlebells Often unbalanced or hollow-feeling
Space Requirements Replaces 41 bells Replaces fewer bells
Portability Easy to transport; modular Often bulky or awkward

This positions the product as a premium, competition-grade adjustable kettlebell system—built for real training, not just convenience.

Adjustment Experience

The bell is designed for durability over speed.

  • Typical adjustment time: 60–90 seconds
  • Optimized for safety, stability, and longevity—not fast but fragile mechanisms
  • Easy learning curve after first few uses
  • Clear plate stacking and labeling for intuitive weight setup

A short setup between sets is normal—and ensures the bell lasts for years under heavy use.

Competition Geometry & Feel

This is where it separates itself from dial-adjustable systems.

  • Fixed-width 35 mm handle ensures consistent grip familiarity
  • Standardized window size keeps movements smooth
  • Uniform bell shape mimics fixed competition kettlebells across all weights
  • Maintains predictable pull paths in snatches, swings, cleans, Turkish get-ups, push presses, and jerks

Lifters repeatedly confirm that it "feels like a real comp bell," a key differentiator from Bowflex-style or cast-iron adjustable alternatives.

Versatility & Training Applications

The Adjustable Competition Kettlebell supports every major kettlebell movement:

  • Two-hand and single-hand swings
  • Cleans & clean variations
  • Snatches
  • Turkish get-ups
  • Presses, push presses, & jerks
  • Goblet squats & front-loaded squats
  • Deadlifts, rows, & high pulls
  • Lunges & step-ups
  • Windmills & core anti-rotation work
  • Conditioning complexes
  • Accessories with lighter weight ranges (via plastic bottom add-on)

You effectively replace an entire progression system with one modular tool.

Space & Portability
  • Fits easily in apartments, condos, small home gyms
  • Travels easily (remove plates and pack flat)
  • Ideal for lifters who want serious training without dedicated storage racks
  • Minimal noise—reviewers consistently describe it as "quiet enough for apartments"
Warranty & Support

Your Adjustable Competition Kettlebell is backed by:

  • Lifetime shell warranty
  • Responsive, top-rated customer service
  • Clear online setup support
  • A community of lifters who stand behind the product

Built for performance. Backed for life.

products.title: Dip Belt
products.body_html:
Tired of banging out 30 unweighted dips like it’s just another Tuesday?

Time to level up your bodyweight game with the Bells of Steel Dip Belt — the trusty sidekick for your dips, pull-ups, and makeshift belt squats.

Whether you prefer pulling your gains skyward instead of using a Lat Pulldown Machine, or you're just trying to avoid that awkward wait for equipment hogs at the gym, this dip belt gives you the power to add serious load and serious gains.

Made with durable reinforced stitching, double-layered material, and extra padding where it counts (your spine says thanks), it’s comfy, sturdy, and dare we say... stylish.

products.title: Machined Iron Olympic Weight Plate Sets
products.body_html:
Weight is weight, right? But what if I told you your sloppy, 45lb plates you got for your 16th birthday from the local big box store were lying to you? The process of casting molten hot iron into moulds can be fickle.

Machined iron plates are cast in a specialty casting factory with over 40 years of experience, then finished on a lathe that shaves off excessive weight from the back of the plate, followed by polishing and machining edges for an even smoother, more aesthetic plate.

The machined plates have a guaranteed tolerance of +/- 1% for 45, 35, and 25 and +/- 3% for 15, 10, 5, and 2.5. But we don't stop there; the holes of the plates are cast smaller than the Olympic bar sleeve diameter of 2 inch/50mm to start, then are drilled out with a guaranteed precision hole fit of 50.5mm +.4mm tolerance, meaning your plates fit snug and erect on your bar. Finally, these beauties are 20% slimmer than other weight plates to fit more on your barbell.

If you're looking for an excellent quality but more economical plate, be sure to check out the Mighty Grip Iron Plates.

products.title: Calibrated Powerlifting Plates - KG Sets
products.body_html:
Wickedly precise and colour-coded, the Calibrated Powerlifting Plates are the perfect training plates for powerlifting.

These babies don't just look amazing, they also match IPF specs and outperform machined iron plates.

While they're not IPF-approved, they do check the key boxes: standardized diameters, correct colour-coding, and guaranteed to be within +/-10 grams of the claimed weight.

If you've ever pulled your 1 rep max with iron plates AND with calibrated plates, you know that the two aren't the same. Calibrated plates are thinner and don't extend so far on the sleeves of the bar, so there's less flex in it - making your lifts different and/or noticeably harder.

Which is maybe important to know BEFORE you try to hit a personal record on your final pull, ya know? With our calibrated plates, you'll know EXACTLY how much you're lifting in training, so you'll know your record-breaking attempts are right on the money - plus, they're also more affordable.

To learn more, check out What Are Calibrated Plates.

products.title: Calibrated Powerlifting Plates - LB Sets
products.body_html:
Wickedly precise and colour-coded, the Calibrated Powerlifting Plates are the perfect training plates for powerlifting.

These babies don't just look amazing, they also closely align with IPF specs and outperform machined iron plates. While they're not IPF-approved, they do check the key boxes: standardized diameters, correct colour-coding, and guaranteed to be within +/-10 grams of the claimed weight.

If you've ever pulled your 1 rep max with iron plates AND with calibrated plates, you know that the two aren't the same. Calibrated plates are thinner and don't extend so far on the sleeves of the bar, so there's less flex in it - making your lifts different and/or noticeably harder. Which is maybe important to know BEFORE you try to hit a personal record on your final pull, ya know? The thing is, they're made in pounds instead of kilograms because, well, #freedomunits. But don't let that rain on your parade, they still make excellent training plates for powerlifting.

To learn more, check out What Are Calibrated Plates.

IMPORTANT: Not IPF approved. Precision-cut 50.4mm centre hole might not fit out-of-spec Olympic barbells.

products.title: Adjustable Macebell
products.body_html:
Ever dreamed of wielding an ancient weapon in your castle of gains? Well, here’s the next best thing.

Used by ancient soldiers to prep for combat, the Adjustable Macebell channels your inner warrior while building deep core strength, shoulder mobility, and rotational power.

Unlike traditional fixed macebells, this baby’s fully adjustable (just like our best-selling Adjustable Kettlebells) to save you cash and space.

It comes with six 1kg plates and a simple inner loading system, letting you start light at 6kg and micro-load up to a challenging 12kg.

Plus, adjusting the weights is easy-peasy. Use the included Allen key to undo the bottom screw and remove the bottom part of the shell. Loosen the nut using the included hex nut wrench, then swap whatever plates you need. Simply reverse these steps to reassemble!

The handle diameter is 1.25"/32mm for a solid grip, but it is not so thick that it causes forearm burnout. Plus, the light knurling on the handle keeps your grip safe & secure, so you can keep swinging without worrying about tearing up your hands.

Whether you’re working on 360° swings, 10-to-2 swings, offset presses or more, this adjustable macebell targets the muscles that matter, translating functional strength into real-world performance.

products.title: Swivel Shackles
products.body_html:
When it comes to cable machines, one tiny hero is making a BIG impact: the Swivel Shackles.

Originally made famous by sailing rigs (aye aye, Captain), these mighty little marvels have nestled into the heart of the home gym community for good reason.

Without one, the cable on your cable machine absorbs every twist, turn, and awkward angle you throw at it. Eventually, this can cause cable twists & binds, causing even more unnecessary stress on your gym gear.

But slap on Swivel Shackles and BOOM — your cable attachments rotate freely, torque vanishes, and your cables breathe a sigh of relief. This means no more weird angles on attachments that just don’t quite line up… looking at you, 30-D Handle Bar.

Some savvy lifters clip a swivel shackle to every cable attachment they own. But if you prefer, just keep one permanently attached to the actual cable end(s) of your machine. They’re super simple to use, so handle swaps are quick and easy.

These aren’t some dollar-store knockoffs, either. We handpicked a premium grade that boasts a 450kg weight capacity. That’s strong enough to handle your cable attachments, your next PR, and our trauma from being picked last in gym class.

And unlike other sellers who bake full shipping costs into every pair, we hand-pick and ship all your shackles together, so the cost only increases slightly per pair. This means you get more gear without getting dinged at checkout.

IMPORTANT: Sold as a set of 4 or 8 shackles.

featured_image.alt: Four stainless steel Swivel Shackles from Bells of Steel are displayed in a grid on a white background. Each shackle features a round swivel ring, resembling those seen in premium gym equipment, and all hooks are open and facing the same direction.

Eight Bells of Steel Swivel Shackles, resembling gym cable machine hooks, are arranged in two rows of four on a plain white background. Each shackle features a circular ring on top and a trigger-style clasp at the bottom.

products.title: Crumb Bumper Plate Sets
products.body_html:
It's time to bump up your lifting game. These crumb bumper plates have a thick stainless steel insert ring with 3 anchor points to prevent common bumper breakdowns.

The crumb material is quieter than urethane bumpers. Ideal for lifters who don't have a platform and features coloured flecks for easier weight identification. The number one advantage of bumpers is safety for the lifter. A lifter who hesitates to dump a bad lift because they're afraid of damage to the floor or the equipment is more likely to get hurt.

Bumpers take any worry about damage completely out of the equation.

Iron plates come in a variety of non-standardized diameters, so if you are doing any exercises pulling from the floor, such as deadlifts, or cleans, unless you have 45lb plates on each side, you'll be pulling from a deficit. Not the case here.

Cheap bumpers can be up to 10% off the claimed weight, causing you to put the wrong weight on the bar. Our bumper plates are accurate to +/- 1% of the claimed weight. No more second-guessing what's on the bar - ever.

NOTE: We're discontinuing the 55 LBS plates, so grab yours while supplies last. The Crumb Bumpers are RoHS-compliant.

products.body_html:

The weight vest stays close to your body, so you can focus on form. Plus, you can clip the oversized rings on the front and back to your Dreadmill or sled-pull attachments… because nothing says "fun" like dragging a sled down your alley.

There’s even a phone holder right on the chest, so you can jam to your workout playlist without your pocket overflowing with a bulky smartphone. Wear it for workouts, walks, or everyday tasks, and turn every movement into a chance to get healthier.

products.title: Omni Bar
products.body_html:

Ready to unlock your workout potential? Enter The Omni Bar— developed in partnership with Bald Omni Man (Coach Paris Butler) — your new secret weapon for smashing PRs.

In Coach Butler's words:

"I loved the original Arch Nemesis Bar, so I proposed substantial quality of life upgrades that would make it even more accessible than it already is. Namely, the rackable length and the knurling.

This means The Omni Bar fits into more power racks and bench stations, and the tough, yet not overly aggressive knurling ensures each rep feels extremely stable and locked in. 

The increased knurling makes cable machine rows, pulldowns, and all arm exercises more practical to perform as well. Because dropping the bar mid-lift is NOT over 9,000 if you know what I'm saiyan.

Sleek laser-cut end caps and a rugged black sand powder coat finish deliver durability and style, while the bar proudly displays “Omni” and “In Strength We Trust” so your lifts look as legendary as they feel. A personal favorite hack of mine is to set the Omni Bar high into a squat rack and use it to perform neutral grip pull-ups!

Overall, it has been a long, yet rewarding process to bring you a truly amazing product, and I am truly excited for you all to try it out. As a gift to you, I have adapted and customized one of my most popular training splits (link below) to include the Omni Bar exercise variations to give you a head start on your gains!"

Click here to grab the Omni Hypertrophy Program.

IMPORTANT: The Omni Bar’s steel tubing sleeves won't rotate like a traditional barbell sleeve, but they do have a 49.7mm diameter. This means they fit Olympic collars, so specialty axle collars are NOT needed.
