products.title: Kraken Rack Attachment for 6 Post Manticore Racks (Single Side)
products.body_html:
The Kraken is a compact rack-mounted cable system, turning your 3” x 3” 6-post power rack with 1” holes into a dual-handle cable tower with 5lbs to 210+lbs of resistance! All of this while maintaining the use of your barbell and rack attachments.

It comes in two versions: 
- Plate-Loaded: use your weight plates to save big bucks
- Weight Stack: a convenient 210-pound stack for quick, no-fuss adjustments

Thanks to the knurled handle, nylon rollers and chrome-coated pop pins, the trolleys are adjustable with a single hand. By using your uprights’ holes for height selections, you can fine-tune the feel of nearly all your cable exercises.

The Kraken saves the clangin’ & bangin’ for your barbell lifts; its aluminum pulleys and dual guide rods deliver the kind of velvety smoothness you'd expect at a commercial gym — but without the crowds, the dude grunting in the corner, and that fit-fluencer hogging the Smith Machine for “just one more angle.”

The dual aluminum handles have 6002 bearings, rotating as smoothly as a barbell, and allow bilateral exercises from a single upright. A single cable features a 2:1 pull ratio (10lbs feels like 5lbs), tackling everything from rehab work to isolations. Plus, the cable travel offers uninterrupted focus during sport-specific drills or while getting that joooooicy bicep pump.

When connected with the cable adapter, the Kraken converts into a glorious 1:1 pull ratio — perfect for heavy lat pulldowns & low rows — with no need to buy a separate weight pack expansion down the road.

Safety is no afterthought either — the Weight Stack version features an optional Shroud that does double duty: protecting fingers (big and small) AND acting as a pegboard, keeping your cable attachments neatly stowed using their included hooks. This means more family time while keeping your little ones safe… because a home gym shouldn't need a “Caution: Dangerous Sh*t EVERYWHERE” sign.

A Single Side of the Kraken Includes:
- Two aluminum handles
- One cable adapter
- Aluminum pulley wheels
- Cables
- Trolley
- Guide rods
- Weight carriage or weight stacks
- Mounting brackets
- Mounting hardware

products.body_html:
The Kraken is a compact rack-mounted cable system, turning your 3” x 3” 4-post power rack with ⅝” or 1” holes into a dual-handle cable tower with 5lbs to 210+lbs of resistance! All of this while maintaining the use of your barbell and rack attachments.

It comes in two versions: 
- Plate-Loaded: use your weight plates to save big bucks
- Weight Stack: a convenient 210-pound stack for quick, no-fuss adjustments

Thanks to the knurled handle, nylon rollers and chrome-coated pop pins, the trolleys are adjustable with a single hand. By using your uprights’ holes for height selections, you can fine-tune the feel of nearly all your cable exercises.

The Kraken saves the clangin’ & bangin’ for your barbell lifts; its aluminum pulleys and dual guide rods deliver the kind of velvety smoothness you'd expect at a commercial gym — but without the crowds, the dude grunting in the corner, and that fit-fluencer hogging the Smith Machine for “just one more angle.”

The dual aluminum handles have 6002 bearings, rotating as smoothly as a barbell, and allow bilateral exercises from a single upright. A single cable features a 2:1 pull ratio (10lbs feels like 5lbs), tackling everything from rehab work to isolations. Plus, the cable travel offers uninterrupted focus during sport-specific drills or while getting that joooooicy bicep pump.

When connected with the cable adapter, the Kraken converts into a glorious 1:1 pull ratio — perfect for heavy lat pulldowns & low rows — with no need to buy a separate weight pack expansion down the road.

Safety is no afterthought either — the Weight Stack version features an optional Shroud that does double duty: protecting fingers (big and small) AND acting as a pegboard, keeping your cable attachments neatly stowed using their included hooks. This means more family time while keeping your little ones safe… because a home gym shouldn't need a “Caution: Dangerous Sh*t EVERYWHERE” sign.

A Single Side of the Kraken Includes:
- Two aluminum handles
- One cable adapter
- Aluminum pulley wheels
- Cables

- Guide rods
- Weight carriage or weight stacks
- Mounting brackets
- Mounting hardware

products.title: Smith Machine Rack Attachment
products.body_html:
Overview

The Smith Machine Rack Attachment turns your existing rack — Hydra, Manticore, 84" Light Commercial, or most 2.3"–3" racks — into a smooth, guided Smith machine without stealing a single extra inch of floor space. Sneaky, right?

Pick the classic built-in Smith bar, or go BYOB (Bring Your Own Barbell) and run your favorite bar inside the guided rails. You get the safety and consistency of a Smith, plus the familiar feel of the bar you already know and love. More control, more confidence, fewer "please don't let this rep be the one that takes me out" moments.

Recommended Set-Up: Mount the upper brackets to the top of your uprights & the lower brackets to your crossmembers (inside rack) or front foot stabilizers (outside rack). Brackets can be mounted to your uprights only, but a dropped bar could permanently damage the unit.

Who It's For
  • Beginners — Guided bar path builds confidence and reduces risk while learning core movements like squats, bench, and presses.
  • Intermediate Lifters — Train heavy without a spotter, maintain consistent form, and use higher volume safely.
  • Advanced Athletes — Use it for hypertrophy work, accessory lifting, pre-exhaust sets, and high-rep training where stability matters.
  • Small-Space Home Gym Owners — Get full Smith machine functionality without dedicating 4–6 feet of floor space to a standalone machine.
  • Couples / Households with Mixed Experience Levels — The fixed bar path makes lifting safer and more accessible for partners new to strength training.
  • Rack Owners Who Don't Want to Replace Their Setup — Add a Smith machine to your existing rack — no need to buy a new cage or proprietary setup.
Exercises — Lower Body
  • Squats
  • Split squats / Bulgarian split squats
  • Lunges
  • Hack squat variations
  • Calf raises
Exercises — Upper Body
  • Flat bench press
  • Incline bench press
  • Decline press
  • Shoulder press
  • Upright rows
Exercises — Back & Accessory Work
  • Smith machine rows
  • Hip hinges / RDL variations
  • Shrugs
Exercises — Core
  • Smith machine ab roll variations
  • Kneeling Smith machine core drags
Compatibility — Bells of Steel Racks

The Bar Included version also fits 47" wide racks by placing the spacers on the inner side of each mounting bracket — watch this video for more compatibility details.

Hydra & Manticore – 4-Post Racks

  • Heights: 72" (outside uprights only), 84", 90", 108"
  • Widths: 47" or 49"

Hydra & Manticore – 6-Post Racks

  • Heights: 72" (outside uprights only), 84", 90", 108"
  • Widths: 47" or 49"

Hydra Flat-Foot / 4-Post

  • Heights: 72" (outside uprights only), 84", 90" (see note), 108"
  • Width: 49"
  • Mounts at a slight angle by default
  • For straight-up-and-down travel, an extra-long bolt kit and additional bushings are required
  • The 56" Hydra Flat Foot requires the Conversion Kit for vertical travel
  •  The 90" Hydra Flat Foot requires side crossmembers to be lowered to accommodate Smith Machine.

Hydra & Manticore Squat Stand

  • Heights: 72", 84", 90" (Manticore Only), 108"
  • Width: 49"
  • Mounts at a slight angle by default
  • For straight-up-and-down travel, an extra-long bolt kit and additional bushings are required

Hydra / Manticore Folding 4-Post Racks

  • Heights: 72", 84", 90", 108"
  • Widths: 47" (Manticore only) or 49"
  • When installed, the rack cannot fold unless the bar is removed

84" Light Commercial Rack

  • Compatible when mounted on the inside at an angle
  • Requires all upper crossmembers to be lowered by one hole
  • This configuration is not compatible with the Lat Pulldown Attachment
Compatibility — Non-BoS Racks

The Smith Machine Rack Attachment fits most non-BoS power racks with:

  • Tubing between 2.3" × 2.3" and 3" × 3"
  • Rack height 72" or taller
  • Rack width 47" or 49"
  • Side hole size 5/8" or 1"

Installation Note: For the smoothest travel, ensure uprights are level, square, and evenly tightened — especially on non-BoS racks.

Installation Expectations
  • Ships in multiple boxes
  • Typical install time: 60–120 minutes
  • Two people recommended for positioning the guide rods
  • Alignment is straightforward on Hydra/Manticore; may require minor adjustments on non-BoS racks
  • Light lubrication optimizes bearing and rotation smoothness

products.title: Tibialis Trainer Bar
products.body_html:
The tibialis trainer bar is your first defense against knee & shin injuries.
When strong, it protects your knees by absorbing deceleration forces while landing from a jump or pivoting on the field. When weak, it can cause knee pain and hobble-worthy shin splints.
Luckily, this tibialis trainer bar is all you KNEE-d. Sorry. Couldn’t resist.
Crank out standard tib raises, or use it for hanging hip flexor raises to strengthen your hip flexors. Better yet, bust out some leg extensions or lay supine on a bench to hit those hamstring curls.
The eyelet can connect to your Cable Tower or Belt Squat Machine. Or, attach a resistance band to it for heavy eccentrics.
IMPORTANT: Loading sleeve fits 2” Olympic weight plates only.

Revitalize your Deadlift Pads with new Replacement Covers!
Identical to the original covers: durable 600 Denier Polyester covers, heavy-duty zippers, and wide Velcro edging to transform them into makeshift jerk blocks.
Easy to clean and install, these covers are the budget-friendly solution to refreshing your pads’ appearance & extending their lifespan by protecting the foam padding inside.
IMPORTANT: Leaving a loaded barbell on the Deadlift Pad Covers will prematurely wear them down. We recommend storing your pads away when not in use.

products.title: Powerlifting Bar
products.body_html:
A whippy gym-class barbell? You're not serious yet. A 1,500 LBS / 680 KG slab of stiff steel with knurl that bites? Now we're talking.

This is a powerlifting bar. Not a hybrid. Not a "good enough." Built to IPF specs without the jacked up certification price tag: 29 mm shaft, powerlifting-only knurl marks, center knurl, aggressive knurling cut that actually grips.

It does three things: squat, bench, deadlift. Sure, you can use it for rows, lunges, and good mornings, but those are just gravy on your meat and potatoes. (Need a bar that does everything without apology? The Multi-Purpose Utility Bar is your huckleberry.)

44.09 LBS / 20 KG. 86-5/8" / 2,200 mm overall length. 16-15/16" / 430 mm of loadable sleeve per side — enough for any plates you own and the ones you'll buy when the PRs start stacking up. Speaking of plates: if you're training seriously for competition, load it with Calibrated Powerlifting Plates — thinner profile, IPF color coding, and within +/- 10 grams of claimed weight.

TWO FINISHES. One mission.

  • Bare Steel (AKA The Barenaked Powerlifting Bar): Raw, reactive, built for chalk. Develops a natural patina over time. For the lifter who doesn't care how it looks as long as it performs.
  • Black Cerakote: Same bar, corrosion-resistant finish that keeps it looking sharp session after session. For the lifter who trains in humid basements or wants a dark and moody vibe.

Garage Gym Reviews named it BEST BUDGET POWER BAR three years in a row. Hundreds of reviews. 4.9/5 stars. 97% recommend. The most common review starts with "the knurling…" and ends with "…PR'd."

Same 1,500 LBS / 680 KG capacity. Same 29 mm shaft. Same IPF-spec geometry as bars priced two-to-four times higher.

Load it up and get that next PR.

products.title: Rack Attached Storage Basket
products.body_html:
Tame gym clutter with the Rack Attached Storage Basket!
This isn’t your grandma’s picnic basket. It’s crafted from 14-gauge steel and built to withstand the rigors of any serious gym environment.
Thanks to the rugged design, all your fitness accessories are safe inside its fortress walls. Use a couple of Utility Hooks to hang your lever belt & lifting chains from the outside of the basket for even more #spacegainz
Mount it on your power rack, storage system, or wall studs.
IMPORTANT: Comes standard with rack-mounting hardware for tubing with ⅝” holes. Wall mounting hardware not included.

products.title: Gymnastics Rings
products.body_html:
Train like a gymnast right at home with Gymnastics Rings!

This bodyweight training tool is easy to secure to your power rack, wall-mounted pull-up bar, or ceiling joists.

Unlike a fixed pull-up bar or dip station, rings are unstable. This means your stabilizers are firing on all cylinders, and you’ll also get a solid core workout, so it’s a great 2-for-1 deal. Overload your exercises using a dip belt.

Use them indoors or outdoors — weather permitting. They’re lightweight and portable, so you can take them on the road and finally be that fitness fanatic working out in the park.

IMPORTANT: Ensure the anchor point of your straps is secure. If mounting to your ceiling, anchor points MUST be bolted securely to ceiling joints.

products.title: Hydra Bumper Plate Tree Builder
products.body_html:
Maximize every inch of your home gym with the Hydra Bumper Plate Tree!
This storage unit is modular, so it adapts WITH you during different phases of your life, like moving to a new home or redesigning your gym space. It’s also expandable for when you’re ready to take over your living room…pending spousal approval, of course.
Its compact footprint maximizes your precious floor space by storing your bars & plates vertically. And thanks to the heavy-duty casters, scooting it to a new area is easy peasy.
Even better, the uprights are from our Hydra ecosystem. This means they’re compatible with Hydra rack attachments.
Supercharge your Bumper Plate Tree with a pack of Utility Hooks to hang resistance bands, lifting chains, and your collection of belts along the centre upright. FINALLY. You can let your inner neat freak run free.

products.title: Hydra Crossmember for Plate Tree
products.body_html:
Plate Tree crossmembers are the horizontal bars along the bottom of your Hydra Plate Tree. They’re easy to install, and they add stability and strength while opening it up to more possibilities for storage.
IMPORTANT: Requires two 24mm wrenches to install (not included by default). Correctly sized box-end, adjustable & socket wrenches are suitable alternatives.

products.title: Hydra Bumper Plate Tree Reinforcement Plates
products.body_html: Our Hydra Bumper Plate Tree Reinforcement Plates add extra stability to your plate tree to make sure it doesn't come tumbling down. If a plate tree falls in the forest does it make it sound? With these bad boys, we'll never know!

products.title: Cable Crossover Machine
products.body_html:
Unlock the cable crossover exercise at home with the Cable Crossover machine or transform your existing Cable Towers with a standalone Cable Cross Converter!

Choose your own adventure with plate-loaded and weight-stack options: Olympic Weight Plate loadable sleeves keep costs low and possibilities high, while the 210-pound Weight Stack version is the crème de la crème of convenience.

Enjoy incredible versatility with dual adjustable handles and 33 height settings on each stack for dozens of cable exercises, and rack attachment compatible 2.3" x 2.3" (60mm x 60mm) tubing—when you're done channeling your inner Wolverine, of course.

Throw on a Y-Dip Attachment, a Seal Row Pad, a blanket to make a fort a few Utility Hooks, and you've got yourself the fitness fortress you've always dreamed about. Plus, a multi-grip ergonomic pull-up bar helps you get even more from this masterful machine.

The 80.75” height fits great in basements, while the 90” height is ideal for taller users as it increases the range of motion for exercises like tricep pushdowns, and allows for pull-ups without as much knee bending.

The converter member adds 87" to the cable tower setup and 98" from upright to upright. At 12-feet in length when assembled, this beast requires some room to fly (and row and curl), but the minuscule 28.5" width makes up for it.

At least, that's the argument we recommend with your spouse. Plus, you can totally hang your laundry here. Go ahead and ditch the dryer.

Need a rack & cable combo machine? Check out the All-In-One Trainer or the Cable Tower Squat Stands!

IMPORTANT: Due to their small footprint and tall height, Cable Towers MUST be bolted down to ensure the user and equipment’s safety. Mounting hardware is not included — we recommend Tapcon+ screws. Ships unassembled.

products.body_html:

The black powder coat offers rust resistance, and the 220lb max capacity can handle your barbell, even if you use it as a makeshift coat rack (please don't).

products.title: Curved Squat Bar
products.body_html:
So you’ve been in the gym squatting and benching like there’s no tomorrow and hitting all the PR’s. But all that huge weight you’ve been slangin’ around is beatin’ up your shoulders & elbows.
Enter the Curved Squat Bar. 
This isn’t just some super-bent bar. The Curved Squat Bar is strategically designed to alleviate stress from your wrists, elbows, and shoulders while squatting and benching. Similar to a traditional straight barbell, you grip the bar like a proper squat or bench but with significantly less pressure on your joints. 
It’s the perfect bar for off-season training and one of the best options for pushing up your volume during your competitive season without as much joint strain. And unlike a Safety Squat Bar, the Curved Squat Bar can be used for upper body movements—like the bench press! It adds several inches to your range of motion to help strengthen your press of the chest and assist with muscular development.
IMPORTANT: The Curved Squat Bar is significantly longer, thicker, and heavier than a typical Olympic barbell. To avoid the bar flipping when racked, sandwich j-cups are strongly recommended.

products.title: Suspension Spotter Straps And Bodyweight System
products.body_html:
These safety spotter straps double as a bodyweight suspension training system for an unbeatable blend of barbell and bodyweight training. 
With a burly 700lb capacity, this spotter system has your back during heavy squats, letting you safely bail if things go awry. Or throw on some handles and complement the heavy days with inverted rows, chest presses, core work, and more.

Don't just exercise; suspend your disbelief and redefine what's possible in your home gym!

The Suspension Spotter Straps and Bodyweight System is a complete system that includes the following:
  • - A pair of Suspension Straps with a chain, clip, and shackle for easy height adjustment.
  • - Rack protector straps with a triangulated steel piece at the bottom to slide your suspension straps into easily.
  • - Pair of handles with four rings for height adjustment and a thick rubber handle.

products.title: Competition Plate Rack
products.body_html:
Keep your competition, cast iron, or calibrated plates organized and ready for your next PR. A must-have for powerlifters and strength clubs.

With a smart dish rack design for plates, 5 storage posts for clips and accessories, and a convenient shelf, you'll have everything you need (like snacks) within reach. Convenient lockable wheels make your loaded storage rack easy to move around, so you don't waste valuable energy walking a few steps across the gym (ew, cardio.)

The burly 661lb max capacity gives you a solid lifting goal to aim for. White lights all the way, babyyy.

products.body_html:
The Mighty Grip Olympic weight plates feature a beautiful, ergonomic design with an ultra-durable hammertone powder coat for superior toughness and resistance to chipping.

The precision grip handles make loading plates onto the bar and re-racking plates a breeze, and they're large enough for even huge hands.

The comfort grip also allows the plates themselves to be used for exercises like steering wheels and farmers' carries.

These plates are excellent quality iron plates made in a factory with over 40 years of casting experience. Because they are only cast and not machined, some minor blemishes and a +/-3% weight tolerance / 51mm hole are standard in the plates.If you're looking for a precision fit and machined-to-perfection plate, be sure to check out our Machined Iron Plates.

products.title: Coloured Bumper Plates
products.body_html:
Designed to catch your eye, while adding to the lifespan of your home gym.

These non-smelly, coloured bumper plates have a thick stainless steel insert ring with 3 anchor points to prevent common bumper breakdowns. Coloured bumpers are not just aesthetically pleasing, they offer additional functionality.

It can often be frustrating trying to quickly and easily identify the plates you need for your workout. With their eye-catching colours, this is no longer an issue with the Coloured Bumper Plates.

Iron plates come in a variety of non-standardized diameters, so if you are doing any exercises pulling from the floor, such as deadlifts, or cleans, unless you have 45lb plates on each side, you'll be pulling from a deficit.

Cheap bumpers can be up to 10% off the claimed weight, causing you to put the wrong weight on the bar. Our bumper plates are accurate to +/- 1% of the claimed weight. No more second-guessing what's on the bar - ever.

products.title: Hydra 2-Sided Rack
products.body_html:
The Hydra 2-Sided Rack Builder is excellent for running highly efficient team training without taking up the floor space of a Hydra Rig.

Everything that is pictured is included: 84" uprights, 30" crossmembers, 13" plate pegs and more! Additional Hydra attachments are optional. The uprights measure true 3" x 3" which is EXACTLY 76.2mm x 76.2mm, instead of the typical 75mm x 75mm uprights of other brands' imported racks.

By matching the same tubing specs as many of our American competitors, you can mix and match attachments freely without needing to stick to one brand - hello, open ecosystem! Built with modular components, so you can divide it into smaller Hydra racks to accommodate a new home gym space or family workouts with your kids. Best of all, you can gaze into your swolemate's eyes while you lift.

IMPORTANT: The Hydra series of power racks are TRUE 3" x 3" tubing with 5/8" holes, so only Hydra attachments & non-B.o.S. attachments made precisely for 76.2mm x 76.2mm uprights with 1" holes will fit.

products.title: Gold / Black Titanized Bolts for Hydra
products.body_html:
Elevate your power rack game with our premium titanized gold or black bolts—because who says luxury doesn't belong in the gym?

These M16x120mm bolts are compatible with power racks with TRUE 3"x3" uprights with 5/8" holes, like our fan-favourite Hydra series. The titanized coating provides an extra layer of protection against rust and corrosion to keep your rack secure for the long haul.

Sure, we're all about putting the fun in functionality, but have you tried looking real fancy? Squatting with your pinkies out while wearing a top hat? No? Well, this is the next best thing.

products.title: 12-32 KG Expansion Pack - For 12-20.5 KG Adjustable Kettlebell
products.body_html:
When the 20.5kg limit of your adjustable kettlebell no longer challenges you, this pack affordably expands your existing bell’s weight range from 12-20.5kg to 12-32kg.

This 13kg expansion pack includes the following plates: 2x 4kg, 1x 3kg, 1x 2 kg. With it, you’ll save the expense and space of acquiring a whole new adjustable kettlebell. Scoop up the Plastic Bottom piece for a lighter range — perfectly suited for single-arm exercises & beginners alike.

products.title: Utility Seat for Hydra/Manticore
products.body_html:
Step ups? Check. Seal Rows? Check. A place to scroll through Instagram between sets? Check check. The Utility Seat tucks conveniently in your 3"x3" rack for a versatile, easy-to-move solution to exercises like split squats. Yeah... you don't have an excuse to skip those now. Sorry about that.
Bolt down the optional bench pad for comfort during hip thrusts, seal rows or Instagram reps, and adjust the height as needed by popping out the hitch pins, then adjusting the safeties, and popping them back in. It's like if your favorite weight bench and an elevator had a very flat, stable baby. Weird analogy...moving on!
The seat is steel-reinforced wood, so it doesn't require every morsel of your strength to move. And when you're done, don't worry about wheeling back and forth like you're trying to do a 25-point turn in a semi-truck. Just detach your bench and tuck it out of the way until next time. That's a big 10-4 on convenience.

IMPORTANT: Fits TRUE 3"x3", 49-inch width racks with 5/8" or 1" holes.

products.body_html:
Unlock versatile exercises in minimal space with the 3-in-1 Soft Foam Plyo Box. Dense foam provides a shin-friendly jumping experience, while the tough vinyl is built to last for years.
Can't finish your set at the current height? No problem-o, pal. Just flip to another height and get down with your bad self. This versatile home gym staple has a 350lb capacity and unlocks step-ups, box jumps, push-ups, tricep dips, and the dreaded Bulgarian split squat. Lucky you!
IMPORTANT: Always land your feet in the centre of the landing surface to avoid tipping. Use on non-slip floors only.

products.title: Blitz Mountain Climber Treadmill
products.body_html:
The Blitz Mountain Climber Incline Treadmill is your ticket to hitting the trail in peak physical form. This cardio machine ranges from a -5% decline to a seriously humbling 50% incline.

Its expansive handles help you hold on for dear life stay safe and secure, and simulate the assistance of trekking poles. Walk as slow as 0.5km/hr or at a neck-breaking “BEAAAAAAR!” pace of 8km/hr.

Its 24-inch touchscreen and metrics will give you sky-high confidence. The pulse grips monitor your heart rate in real time, and all other basic metrics are covered. Thanks to its FTMS Bluetooth connectivity, you can pair select apps like FitShow, Kinomap, and Zwift for engaging workouts.

Its 2.5CHP motor & cushioning system supports users up to 300 pounds. This way, you can practice for when you neglect the pounds-are-pain motto and ascend 2,500 feet with a case of beer… At least your friends will appreciate you.
The Blitz Mountain Climber Incline Treadmill will be discontinued. Grab yours while supplies last!

IMPORTANT: The Blitz Mountain Climber is not designed for running due to the shorter length of the running deck. Minimum 7.5-foot ceiling height required for the average user. Ships partially assembled.

products.title: Casters for Hydra Upright (Set of 4)
products.body_html:
Casters are wheels with brackets that make moving objects easier. Bolt them to your Hydra storage units for easier (though, not effortless) moving and without having to unload everything or disassemble them.

IMPORTANT: Requires two 24mm wrenches to install (not included by default). Correctly sized box-end, adjustable & socket wrenches are suitable alternatives.

products.title: Dumbbell/Kettlebell Shelf
products.body_html:
Whether you've got a sprawling home gym or a cozy lifting nook, instantly reclaim valuable floor space with the Dumbbell/Kettlebell Shelf!

Choose from three versatile lengths — 70”, 43”, or 30” — to elevate your weight storage and transform any area into a clutter-free fitness haven. Because tripping over kettlebells isn't a recommended warm-up.

Flat mounting secures your kettlebells neatly, while an angled installation makes grabbing dumbbells a breeze. As your impulse equipment purchases multiply, this versatile shelf easily adapts to match your evolving fitness journey.

Plus, skip the complicated manual and trip to the hardware store. Just mount the shelf to four uprights spaced 17" apart, secure it with the included hardware, and voilà — an equipment assembly without an epic meltdown.

And even if your deadlift still needs work (speaking for ourselves here), your gym can still look elite. The powder-coated black finish and minimalist style give your gym a polished aesthetic.

products.title: Chest Expander
products.body_html:
Don't let the name fool you: this bodybuilding classic targets the back, triceps, biceps, and more.

It's been a staple in bodybuilding for over a century for its effectiveness and versatility in building lean, defined muscle with that wiry, natural look.

Built for progression, this steel contraption has 7 springs with carabiner attachments, so you can remove or double up springs, adjusting the tension to suit your goals and experience level. When fully stretched, each spring provides 20lbs of resistance.

Beginners and pros alike can use this for curls, flyes, and rows or attach to a fixed point for presses. Grab two for even more versatility (shameless upsell!)

The chest expander offers consistent tension throughout the movement regardless of how many springs are attached, making it optimal over bands for bodybuilding.

The design hasn't changed much over the past century because it hasn't needed to, but we've thrown on rotating handles and knurling for that cherry on top of a swole sundae.

Watch your arm hair, though—and if you see Kaevon walking around looking smoother than a baby porpoise, mind your business.

IMPORTANT: Use a minimum of two springs on opposing ends of the handles to avoid over-stretching them. The warranty on the springs is 3 months, as they are considered a perishable item.

products.title: Blitz Max Air Bike
products.body_html:
Most air bikes make you choose: unresisted chaos or controlled, precise magnetic training. The Blitz Max doesn't. It does both — simultaneously, on the same ride, with a lever your hand can reach mid-sprint.This is the top of the B.o.S. air bike lineup. Commercial-grade frame. Hybrid resistance. Built for the kind of athlete who's done the research, knows exactly what they want, and is tired of compromising.

HYBRID AIR + MAGNETIC RESISTANCE. The 25" / 635 mm 7-blade steel fan meets your effort with matching resistance: push harder, it fights harder, no ceiling, no mercy. Dial in one of 8 magnetic levels for repeatable, data-driven intervals where you actually know what you're working against session to session. The adjustable damper lets you tune the air feel independently. Open it up in summer. Keep it closed on those brutal January mornings when the garage is 4°C and you'd rather be anywhere else.

138 LBS / 62.6 KG OF FRAME that does not move during intense sessions. The commercial-grade steel footprint stays planted through max-output sprints from the most powerful athletes, and the oversized turf tires mean one person can still roll the whole thing across turf without drama. A centre flat step makes entry and exit easier for athletes managing mobility challenges, which is a detail most brands skip entirely.

EIGHT SEAT HEIGHT SETTINGS (33"–39.375" / 838–1,000 mm), 5 fore/aft positions, and 4-way tilt. Two sets of ergonomic rubber-wrapped handles with multiple grip positions: wide for chest and shoulders, narrow for arms, secure whether you're fresh or dripping.

330 LBS / 150 KG CAPACITY. The console runs on real physical buttons with colour-coded START/STOP included, because changing programs mid-sprint shouldn't require a second attempt. Bluetooth and ANT+ sync whatever's on the integrated tablet/phone holder.

Reviewers say this bike handles everything thrown at it and doesn't flinch. One reviewer at 240 lbs, said the frame didn't move even when they tried to make it sway. That's the Blitz Max.

Not ready for commercial grade? The Blitz Air Bike is the light-commercial sweet spot. Same belt-driven DNA, lighter footprint, lower price.

Want something built for occasional home use? The Residential Air Bike has you covered.

Not sure which is right? The Air Bike overview breaks down the full lineup.

5-YEAR FRAME WARRANTY. 2-year parts warranty. Canada flat-rate (capped at $199 CAD). Add to cart and channel your hatred for cardio in the most productive way possible.

products.body_html:
The Meat Hook Deadlift Jack is a back saver.

Weighing in at a feathery 3.7 lbs with a 500lb capacity, this jack is compact and portable. products.title: The Dreadmill
products.body_html:
The Dreadmill is a lean, hyper-versatile, dread dream machine! This 3-in-1 cardio machine is a farmer walk, sled push, and manual incline treadmill — all rolled into one.

Applying resistance is easy and smooth, thanks to the magnetic resistance lever. By positioning magnets near the flywheel, resistance is generated without any physical contact, ensuring nearly whisper-quiet operation.

Keep it low and light, or crank up the intensity for serious athletic gainzzz. Whether you're warming up, crushing intervals, or tackling endurance training, the Dreadmill's magnetic resistance lever makes it easy to adjust your workouts instantly.

Being self-powered, you’re free to roam away from outlets. Simply lift from the front stabilizer bar to engage the rear wheels and claim a new home base. 

The Dreadmill requires very little maintenance aside from the occasional dusting and belt lubricating — don’t mind the jealous looks from your motorized machine-owning friends.

It folds away to save space, and you can even use the farmer walk handles to mimic Lever Arm exercises! Bust out bent-over rows, bench presses, shrugs, split squats,  calf raises, shoulder presses, and deadlift variations.

Best of all, you can get up to speed with all The Dreadmill’s utility in a single workout. Sorry, Wooden Manual Treadmill — there’s barely any learning curve here.

products.body_html:
The Blitz Air Rower is an economical indoor rowing machine that offers a joint-friendly, full-body workout with a wide range of training potential. Casually row along to build cardiovascular endurance, or HIIT it hard to torch calories.

This low-impact cardio machine has a lower impact than running and skipping, so it's ideal for people with joint issues. The air-powered flywheel and adjustable damper give you control over the intensity of your workout-the harder you row, the more resistance you'll get. 

The ergonomic design and adjustable footrests make it easy to use, and the quick disassembly and front-mounted wheels make it easier to put away after your sweat session.

Version 2: Features an additional carabiner clip, so you can swap out the default handle for any cable attachment.

products.title: Reverse Hammer 2 In 1 GHD And Reverse Back Extension
products.body_html:
The Reverse Hammer is two essential products for your home gym - Reverse Back Extension & Glute Ham Developer (GHD) - combined into one, at a fraction of the cost (and space) of separate machines. The fusion of the Reverse Back Extension machine and Glute Ham Developer (GHD) is a Bells of Steel original design and was engineered in-house. 

The Reverse Back Extension is an excellent movement for the lower back, glutes, and hamstrings because it allows one to train the whole of the posterior chain in a way that is very similar to the deadlift, but without actually loading up the spine. This makes the Reverse Back Extension the perfect movement for athletes with a pre-existing low back issue or those who want to give their lower back a break without missing a training session.

Meanwhile, the Glute Ham Raise is an incredibly useful exercise for isolating the hamstrings and the glutes, increasing hypertrophy to these two essential muscle groups. It's also believed to be superior to the leg curl because it works more muscles and puts a greater emphasis on the eccentric component of knee flexion. Increased time under tension, a more complete range of motion, and the ability to add resistance with bands or weight plates make for a very targeted approach to hamstring and glute development that will carry over to your heavy squats, deadlifts, and your explosiveness on the playing field.

It features a vertically adjustable footplate/foot roller carriage that accommodates users of any height. The diamond-plate platforms facilitate stepping up into the GHD, with a removable crotch pad so the fellas don’t damage the goods. Side handles make getting in and out easier, and extra padding over the curved part of the pad for more comfortable reverse back extensions. Add cable attachments and resistance bands for upper body work and build lower body strength, power, and explosiveness without putting your spine through a heavy-duty stress test.

products.title: Wall-Mounted Plate Storage Rack
products.body_html:
Vertical storage is like a pillar of perfection, nay, a beacon of hope, of home gym storage. While we love the rack-mountable plate pegs, we also appreciate wanting more space for attachments.
The Wall Mounted Plate Storage Rack is the best of both worlds. This space-saving storage solution mounts directly to a stud or concrete wall to keep your plates tidy and secure. Four 12.6″ plate pegs and a 793lb total capacity offer plenty of space for your weight plates with 2" holes. Customize the peg spacing to show off your collection in style.
You don't just have to store plates on this, built with the same 2.3 x 2.3 inch tubing power racks, you can also store your rack attachments when not in use, like your dip bar, band pegs, seal row pad and whatever your heart desires.
Hardware included. Ships unassembled.
IMPORTANT: For user and equipment safety, the Wall-Mounted Plate Storage MUST be bolted to a wall stud or into a concrete wall.

products.title: Leg Press Hack Squat Machine
products.body_html:
The barbell squat is a cornerstone. It's also loading your spine every single rep. A dedicated leg press hack squat machine keeps the legs in the equation and takes the spine out of it for more volume, more frequency, less negotiating with your lower back about whether today is actually a training day.

The B.o.S. Leg Press + Hack Squat Machine is two machines in one footprint (plus a bonus third if you count calf raises, which we do) and it hits quads, hamstrings, glutes, and calves without negotiating with your rack for time. Flip the footplate, reposition the back pad, and you're in a completely different exercise. One verified reviewer clocked the switchover at under 30 seconds. (Not a drill. Legs were on fire shortly after. Burn baby, burn.)

1,000 LBS / 454 KG CAPACITY across every angle: leg press, hack squat, calf raise.

The sled rides on LINEAR BALL BEARINGS, not bushings, not roller wheels, which is why it glides instead of grinds.

The frame carries a LIFETIME WARRANTY. Moving parts: 3 years. Pads: 1 year. (The competition gives you 12 months on the whole machine and hopes you don't notice.)

5 racking positions for lifters of every height. Multiple footplate angle settings for both exercises. Band pegs built in: loop on a set of resistance bands to make the top of every rep heavier, which is exactly where most lifters cheat their gains.

Plates store neatly under the sled, so the 87" / 221 cm x 37” / 95.3 cm footprint stays sleek.

Highly recommended by lifters like you. The recurring word in 5-star reviews is "tank." The recurring word in the 4-star reviews? "Wish I had a friend to help assemble it" — which is fair, because at 322 LBS / 146 KG across 6 boxes, this is a buddy-system build, which happens when something is built for the big leagues. (Plan for 2–4 hours and a second set of hands.)

Looking for other ways to put the “Leg” in “LEGendary?” The Belt Squat Machine lets you load your legs without loading your back. And if hamstring curl and leg extension work is on the list, the Basilisk Leg/ Curl Extension rounds out the full leg day lineup without needing another room.

Ships fast from where you are: Calgary and Toronto for Canada (capped at $199 CAD flat-rate or pick-up at our showrooms to save), Melbourne for Australia (capped at $199 AUD flat-rate, no duties or customs, or pick up at our showroom to save), Bristol for the UK (free over £99, no duties or customs). Proudly Canadian. Genuinely global. Add to cart and stop skipping leg day.

IMPORTANT: Assembling the Leg Press Hack Squat Machine is challenging due to the weight and size of the boxes and components. Having a friend to help is strongly recommended.

products.title: Strongman Yoke (2.3" x 2.3", ⅝" HOLES)
products.body_html:
This strongman yoke transforms into multiple tools allowing for more exercises per square foot in your gym space!

The first Yoke seen in Strongman was in the 1977 World's Strongest Man, where a crude, injury-inducing contraption called the fridge carry was used as an event. Since then, it has become a staple at high-level events and local amateur competitions.

Featuring a fully adjustable, extra thick cross piece and reinforced stress points to help prevent bending, twisting, and shaking as you carry up to 700 pounds across your back. The equal distribution of four weight pegs makes the super yoke well-balanced.

Add any of three 60mm j-cup models and spotter arms to create a squat stand for barbell or axel bar work.

A large selection of accessories are available to add versatility and excitement to your workouts, such as lever arms and/or a monolift.

Superior 1" spacing through the bench and pull zone and 2" spacing above and below allow you to select the perfect height for your j-cups for precision lift-offs that can make the difference between a good rep and a superb rep.

J-cups not included by default, check out the extensive range of compatible 2.3" x 2.3" rack attachments click here.

Work your core, hamstrings, and stabilizers — the exercises printed on the ball offer a roadmap to sculpting your body, so you'll never be stuck bouncing away aimlessly!

products.body_html:

products.title: Oly Lifting Needle Bearing Bar - Women's
products.body_html:
The B.o.S. Women's Barbell 3.0 is dollar-for-dollar the best women's weightlifting barbell you can buy.

Olympic weightlifting isn't just a sport, it's an art. This requires a bar to match your skill and strength - the B.o.S. Women's Barbell 3.0 is that masterpiece. In fact, it won Garage Gym Reviews' Best Olympic Weightlifting Bar for Women in 2023!

Looking for a multi-purpose bar instead? You'll love the 25mm shaft & 15kg weight of the Juno Bar - Women's Utility Barbell.

products.title: Wooden Residential Manual Treadmill
products.body_html:
This smooth, self-powered treadmill offers a modern aesthetic — without the maintenance needs of a motorized treadmill. Torch your calories and posterior chain with an 8.4° curve angle, so you don't have to resort to soul-crushing HIIT workouts on a Blitz Air Bike.

This manual treadmill is self-powered, meaning no electricity and no worrying about plug placement-just tip it onto the wheels and move it around to wherever you want. The compact design offers a streamlined 47" x 17.3" running deck and 4-inch wide foot rails. It's ideal for walking and running, but you might want a Blitz Manual Treadmill if you feel the need for speed, especially if you're tall.

112 ball bearings offer an ultra-smooth glide, and the high-strength nylon slats absorb impact to protect your joints and minimize sound. With a 396lb weight capacity, feel free to throw on a Weight Vest to really feel the burn.

IMPORTANT: The Residential Manual Treadmill's shipping box is large and heavy, so it can only ship by freight. Consider recruiting a friend to help you bring it into your home. Ideal for walking/jogging, not sprinting. Ships partially assembled.

products.title: Viking Press Attachment
products.body_html:
A barbell and a rack? Everyone has that. A Viking press landmine attachment in the corner? That's a different gym... and a different kind of shoulder day.

Dust off the beater bar. Drop it into a landmine, load plates, slide the attachment over the sleeve, lock the knob. You're doing the viking press exercise in under a minute, no Strongman meet required.

FOUR GRIP POSITIONS. 2 neutral, 2 regular. Narrow or wide, palms in or palms forward: press the way your shoulders actually want to move. The neutral grip positions stack your elbows directly under your wrists, keeping the shoulder joint in its happy place through the full range of motion; more pressing, fewer "I'll sit this one out" Mondays.

Heavy steel frame. Rust-resistant black powder coat. A locking knob that doesn't wobble mid-rep (looking at you, slide-over sleeves). Built to last, priced like it isn't. That's the B.o.S. thing.

The reviews speak for themselves. One lifter called it "the one thing I was really missing." Another said it kicked their butt harder than anything they'd touched in a long time. We'll take both.

The viking press exercise is just the headline. The real value? This is a 5-exercise kit in disguise.

  • Landmine shoulder press.
  • Single-arm row.
  • Meadows press.
  • T-bar row.
  • Half-kneeling press.

One attachment, an entire shoulder-and-back day, and it all slides onto a 2" Olympic bar you probably already own.

Verified reviews. Near-perfect rating.

Don't have a landmine yet? We've got those too. Need to piece together the rest of your setup? Use the Home Gym Builder tool and save 5%. Otherwise, add it to your cart and get Strongman pressing in your garage by next week.

IMPORTANT: Please note that the locking screw that secures the Viking Press Attachment to your bar could mark up your barbell sleeve over time. We tell you that up front because that's how we do business. (Most lifters don't notice. One reviewer specifically said "haven't noticed any scratches" after months of use.)

products.body_html:

With a 661lb max capacity and 2" thick pad, this basic bench weighs in at a feathery 37.2 lbs, making it easy to move and store while boasting a sturdy 4-legged design for extra support.
With the Flat Utility Bench, you'll be benchin' on a budget in no time.

products.title: Adjustable Utility Bench
products.body_html:
Economical yet effective, the Adjustable Utility Bench is a leaner, cost-effective alternative to the beefy Buzz-Saw Bench or fan-favorite Flat/Incline/Decline Bench.

With a 575lb max capacity and 2.3" thick pad, this basic bench weighs 55lbs, making it easy to move and store while boasting decline, flat, and 5 incline angles to choose from, plus an adjustable seat.

Version 2.0 Upgrades
- Compatible with Bench Attachments using the upcoming Universal Bench Adapter

IMPORTANT: If storing vertically, ensure your floor is level. Uneven flooring may cause the bench to fall when stored upright. Alternatively, use a bench hanger.

products.title: Above Rack Barbell Holder
products.body_html:
Store a barbell above your power rack, converting it into a useable pull-up station - for smarter storage AND a bigger back. The 3D-printed Hydra Barbell Holder Rack Attachment is made to fit perfectly on true 3" x 3" tubing with 5/8" holes but will fit smaller racks with a DIY shim. With a 500lb capacity, this versatile storage solution will hold barbells up to 32mm in diameter.

Place your barbell across the power rack for a makeshift pull-up station, ideal for lifters with a Lat Pulldown attachment. 

We recommend mounting the holder toward the front or rear of your rack to avoid epic fail videos. 

Hardware NOT included. Sold in pairs.

IMPORTANT: Avoid doing butterfly/kipping pull-ups from a barbell in the Hydra Barbell Holder Rack Attachment, as upward motion could cause it to jump out of the holder and cause injury.

featured_image.alt: The Bells of Steel Above Rack Barbell Holder is a black, angular metal accessory with a U-shaped notch and central hole—perfect for securely storing your barbell on your power rack in any home gym.

Two identical Bells of Steel Above Rack Barbell Holders—black metal brackets with U-shaped top notches and lower circular holes—are shown upright on a white background, designed as power rack attachments for barbells.

products.title: Roll of Gym Turf
products.body_html:
Train like a pro on synthetic grass! It's the ultimate choice for athletes at any level. With its soft surface, it minimizes impact injuries. Plus, it's perfect for sled training and keeps your floor safe from damage.

Our turf comes pre-cut at 2m x 25m (6.56 feet x 82 feet) and can make a great addition to your gym. *cries in beep test*

products.title: RocIT Tricep Strap
products.body_html:
Sculpt your arms into a set of triumphantly terrific triceps! Similar to the tricep rope extension, this tricep strap is compatible with any cable machine using a carabiner. And thanks to the open centre hole, you can also use it as a t-bar row attachment! 

The webbing features strong stitching and soft padding inside the dual handles. Built specifically for tricep targeting but also works great for hitting other muscles, too. Set your biceps, shoulders, and core on fire with hammer curls, facepulls, and woodchoppers.

IMPORTANT: Requires a carabiner (not included by default) for use on your cable machine.

products.title: Trifold Mat
products.body_html:
Experience pain-free mobility and floor exercises on hard basement or garage gym floors. 

1.6" of plush, cushy EPE foam with a non-slip surface make your uncomfortable workouts as comfortable as possible. (Burpees not included-those just suck).

When you're done, use the convenient transport handles to fold it and tuck it away. Or keep it under your desk at work for naps. Not that we do that here, Kaevon...

Need more space to nap train? Check out the Four Fold Mat.

products.title: Aluminum Technique Barbell
products.body_html:
It's time to retire your technique dowel! The Aluminum Technique Bar is a 15-pound bar that mimics the look and feel of a regular Olympic bar, but with a fraction of the weight.

Thanks to the 51.5" distance between the sleeves, it's rackable in most power racks, making it perfect for learning and refining your technique on the barbell lifts. 

You can also use it for warm-ups, mobility drills, and accessory exercises. It's suitable for anyone who wants to improve their lifting skills and performance, from beginners to experts.

IMPORTANT: Dropping the Technique Bar should be avoided to extend its lifespan. Due to its aluminum construction, it has a 65lb total weight capacity.

products.title: Tall Rack Lat Pulldown / Row Attachment (for Brute and Utility Rack)
products.body_html:
NOTE: The product has been discontinued.

Build your back with the versatile and compact Tall Rack Lat Pulldown / Row Attachment.

Add this to your Brute Rack or Utility Rack to do lat pulldowns, cable rows, and other cable exercises using the same machine, seamlessly switching between settings while adding only 12" of depth to your existing setup.

With a 285lb weight capacity, you can throw on your existing 1" or 2" weight plates to build strength without sacrificing your space or budget.


IMPORTANT: This Rack Lat Pulldown / Low Row Attachment ONLY fits on the Utility Rack and Brute Rack with Extension - it does NOT fit on our 84.5" or 72" racks. Ships unassembled.

products.title: Tricep Pressdown With Ergo Handgrips
products.body_html:
Sculpt your arms into a set of triumphantly terrific triceps!

The Tricep Pressdown with Ergo Handgrips is compatible with any cable machine using carabiners.

The rubberized grips and large ends are grippy and comfortable to hold, so you work your tris to failure without feeling like you're holding onto a wet spaghetti noodle.

products.body_html:
Your isolation muscles CRAVE variety, just like a gym bro thirsts for their caffeine-ridden pre-workout drink - so, give 'em what they want!

With the Double Hook Straight Bar, you can unlock barbell exercises like presses, rows, deadlifts, and more!

  • Weight Stack All-in-One Trainer
  • Plate Loaded All-in-One Trainer

Pairs great alongside the Double Hook EZ Curl Bar Cable Attachment.

products.title: Blitz Stepper
products.body_html:
Looking for joint-friendly cardio? You'll love the Blitz Stepper. This cardio machine simulates the challenge of climbing stairs, one of the most effective exercises for roasting calories.

With a 330lb weight capacity, the Blitz Stepper is not only effective for cardio-building & fat burning, but it's also comfortable and safe. Padded handles and textured foot plates keep you secure during your climb.

Adjust the 15 levels of magnetic resistance to really feel the burn! Unlike revolving-style stair climbers, the Blitz combines the up/down movement of a traditional stair climber with the low impact of an elliptical machine. The rollers slide smoothly along the solid steel guide rods for no jolts, jarring, or knee pain.

IMPORTANT: The Blitz Stepper requires a minimum ceiling height of 96 inches for the average user. Ships unassembled.

products.title: Squat Stands (2.3" x 2.3", ⅝" HOLES)
products.body_html:
Weighing in at a beefy 73lbs for maximum stability, the Squat Stands 3.0 can be used in home gyms or commercial settings, for instance, weightlifting clubs.

Superior 1" spacing through the bench and pull zone and 2" spacing above and below allow you to select the perfect height for your j-cups, for precision lift-offs that can make the difference between a good rep and a superb rep.

Trying to decide between squat stands and a power rack? Then check out Squat Stands vs Power Racks: How to Choose.

The wheels on the back make it easy to move them out of the way for less important things, like your car, when space is limited.

A large selection of accessories are available to add versatility and excitement to your workouts, such as roller j-cups or a monolift.

IMPORTANT: Stands include a pair of regular j cups. The Squat Stands feature 2.3" x 2.3" tubing with 5/8" holes, which is only compatible with our 60mm rack attachments. Check out the extensive range of compatible 2.3" x 2.3" rack attachments click here.

products.title: Blitz Indoor Cycling Bike
products.body_html:
You know the drill: a packed indoor cycling class, the room lit like a nightclub, someone barking motivational nonsense into a headset mic while you quietly question your life choices. No thanks.

And here's the good news: your home gym doesn't need a $2,000 indoor cycling bike with a subscription attached to it to get the benefits of a class; it needs a spinsational alternative you'll actually get on tomorrow, and the day after that.

The Blitz Indoor Cycling Bike gives you 297 LBS / 135 KG of capacity at a resistance level so quiet the neighbours won't even know you exist. Twist the knob, dial in the effort, and if it gets to be too much, press down for an emergency stop built right into the resistance mechanism. No subscription. No app. No one yelling at you. Just you, the bike, and whatever's on your tablet.

Built on a steel frame designed to survive years of hard intervals. The seat and handlebars each get 6 height positions plus fore/aft adjustment on the seat, a range that covers most riders comfortably. Riders who are at least 5'11" (or 6' on the dating profile) may want to grab the Tall Cycling Bike Seat Post for a more comfortable fit.

Placing a Cardio Machine Floor Mat underneath protects your floors from sweat and vibration, and yes, there will be sweat.

The media shelf up front holds a tablet or laptop, so your show comes with you or so you can burn calories during yet another meeting that should have been an email.

Bottle holder, toe-strap pedals, and drip guards round it out. Nothing flashy. Just the stuff you actually reach for ride after ride.

One reviewer put it best: "This bike is nearly as good as a commercial model but at half the cost." Another said unboxing took longer than assembly, which we consider a great compliment.

More of a suffer-in-intervals type than a steady-state cyclist? The Residential Air Bike scales resistance with your effort. The harder you push, the harder it pushes back.

Want the full commercial-grade fan bike experience? The Blitz Max Air Bike is the top of the lineup.

Not sure which cardio machine fits your space and goals? The complete cardio machine guide breaks it all down.

Add it to your home gym, living room/ lifting room and feel the burn.

products.title: Tricep Pulldown Rope – Single
products.body_html:
Isolate your triceps into a set of triumphantly terrific triceps!

This single tricep pulldown rope is spin-off the classic tricep rope extension, compatible with any cable machine using carabiners.

The nylon ropes and hard plastic ends are durable and long-lasting. Plus, the 25mm diameter comfortable to hold, so you work your tris to failure without feeling like you're holding onto a wet spaghetti noodle.

Built specifically for tricep targeting but also works great for hitting your biceps, shoulders, and core with hammer curls, facepulls, and woodchoppers.

products.body_html:

The handles rotate smoothly and the rubberized grips are comfortable to hold, so you can train to failure without feeling like you're holding onto a wet spaghetti noodle.


IMPORTANT: Requires a carabiner (not included by default) for use on your cable machine.

products.title: Short Utility Barbell
products.body_html:
Couldn't think of another tagline here - we just kept coming up short. Whether you're lifting in a broom closet under the stairs (is that you, Harry?) or looking to optimize the functionality of your space-constrained home gym, a short barbell is a saving grace.

We took our best-selling Utility Barbell and literally trimmed a little off the top.

This means you still get its beloved features; versatile 28.5mm diameter, dual knurl markings, centre knurl for better grip on squats, and a durable black zinc coating. We even matched the sleeve finish for an all-black look that'll turn heads.

Obviously, the rackable version is more practical for squats and bench presses; but with its solid 1,000lb capacity, this non-rackable short barbell takes the cake for deadlifts and Olympic lifts in tight quarters.

IMPORTANT: The Short Utility Bar is shorter than a typical Olympic barbell between the collars, so it's NOT rackable on a standard power rack. For a rackable version, check out the Short Rackable Utility Bar.

products.title: Roll of Gym Flooring (50')
products.body_html:
Made of recycled rubber powder, this ultra-smooth rubber roll is perfect for covering your whole home gym or commercial gym. 
With a home gym you get the joy of adding flooring around awkwardly shaped objects like furnaces, vents, and load-bearing walls. No reason to panic, though! A sharp utility knife and some careful trimming will save the day.
Its easy-to-clean rubber surface simply needs a quick once-over with a mop, and you're good to go. And while mopping is a great warm-up, maybe wait until after you squat so you don't turn your PR into an ER.
Unless the idea of taping together +15 Rubber Gym Mats lights your fire (maybe you REALLY love arts and crafts), then this is an economical alternative to purchasing a bunch of mats and wasting your time doing math when you could be getting muscles. Brains are important, biceps are importanter.
Flooring comes in 50-foot length and 4-foot width rolls, 6mm thick, to protect your gear, floor, and you.
IMPORTANT: We are unable to ship these by UPS, your total order has to be over 500lbs in order to ship by freight, or you can pick up in Calgary or Toronto

products.title: Straight Bar Cable Attachment (20")
products.body_html:
Compatible with any cable machine using carabiners, this 20" straight bar cable attachment is the jack-of-all-trades for cable training.

Its straight design allows for pushdowns, rows, pulldowns, raises and more without needing 93 different cable attachments. The comfortable rubberized grips are gentle on your hands, in case mountainous calluses aren't your thing.

The rotating centre allows for smooth, natural movement without you needing to loosen your grip. This way, you’ll never have to worry about inertia straining your wrists or elbows and causing injury. Plus, it's safer for your noggin' with its rounded rubber ends.

IMPORTANT: Requires a carabiner (not included by default) for use on your cable machine.

products.title: Residential Dumbbell Rack
products.body_html:
Step up your home gym game with the upgraded Residential Dumbbell Rack!

This three-tier Dumbbell Rack can handle up to 1,000lbs and is perfect for your home gym. Each rack fits our 5-50lb set or 55-80lb set of dumbbells.

Its 2' x 4' footprint occupies minimal space in your living lifting room and weighs only 73lbs, making this must-have storage unit easy to assemble and move.

Version 2.0 features: 2.3" x 2.3" tubing with ⅝” holes, so it’s compatible with 2.3” rack attachments.

Need an adaptable storage rack? Check out the Commercial Interchangeable Weight Rack.

Wanting more than three tiers? Check out the Hydra Storage Builder for up to four storage tiers & multiple widths.

IMPORTANT: Fits hex dumbbells & urethane dumbbells. Ships unassembled.

products.title: Short Rackable Barbell
products.body_html:
So your home gym space is limited. Tight room. Low ceiling. Half a garage stall. Compact flat. And somehow you're still trying to squeeze in a full 86.5" Olympic bar like it's going to magically shrink at setup time?

Child, please.

This is the bar for the rest of us. 69” (175 cm) of Olympic shaft. 17” (43 cm) saved. 900 lbs / 408 kg of static capacity. And yes — it still RACKS — up to 49 inches inside width. That’s the B.o.S. line-up of 60mm racks, Hydra, and Manticore. Oh, and if you have one of the matching racks from our BFFs, that works too. *sly wink*

Same 28.5 mm shaft as the best-selling Multi-Purpose Utility Bar. 150,000 PSI tensile steel. Black zinc on the shaft, black zinc on the sleeves — one matched finish, end to end. Bushings and snap rings keep the sleeves spinning quiet and predictable.

Dual IPF and IWF knurl marks mean it works for squats, presses, and pulls without picking sides. Centre knurl, too — most short bars skip it. We didn't. Light knurl pressure for daily training (no shredded palms after week one).

4.9 / 5 across the reviews. The most repeated phrase in those reviews is some version of "finally, a bar that fits."

Two-person home gyms. Narrow racks. Basements with low ceilings. Garage gyms that still function as actual garages. This is the bar people put in those spaces.

If rackability isn’t a big deal to you, and you want more sleeve length, check out the Short Utility Bar. It won’t fit on a rack, but it will rack up your PRs on deadlifts. Pair it with our Hydra Trident Station, drop it into a Manticore rig, or hand it to your training partner in the spare room.

We recommend pairing this with steel plates to load more on your bar. Limited Lifetime warranty on the frame if it ever bends from normal use.

products.title: Adjustable Wall Or Ceiling Mounted Pull Up Bar
products.body_html:
This bare steel pull up bar can be mounted on the ceiling for a vertical drop or directly to your wall with the included mounting hardware. This multipurpose marvel includes two convenient eyelets for mounting our pulley attachment (cable machine exercises, anyone?) or suspension spotter straps (hello ring rows!). The kipping-friendly design leaves plenty of clearance for spirited workouts.
Our bare steel products are coated in oil to minimize oxidation during storage and transit, but you might notice small rust spots upon receipt. To address this, clean the bar with a simple green cleaner and a BBQ brush, then wipe dry with a microfiber cloth. Watch our how-to video for guidance.
IMPORTANT: Warranty applies for structural welds. Bells of Steel is not responsible for the integrity of the installation. Seek advice from the appropriate professionals as to the structural strength of the wall. Failure to install correctly could result in injury!

products.title: Black Puzzle Mat
products.body_html:
Made of recycled rubber cut into a puzzle pattern, these mats are designed to keep together at all times and provide an economical option to keep your floor looking good and protected. 6mm thickness protects your bar and plates, sold in convenient 1m x 1m single sheets.
The smaller, square cuts make them ideal for fitting perfectly into your floor space. 2 mats are the perfect size for a bar with plates, and 4 are ideal for a power rack setup.
A smooth surface makes them easy to clean after you... clean. And jerk. And squat. You know.

products.body_html: It doesn’t actually weigh 45lbs, but your social media followers won’t notice.

products.title: Weight Stack Pin
products.body_html:
Make micro loading on your cable machine a piece of cake with the Weight Stack Pin! Between lateral raises and bicep curls, a full 10lb weight jump can take you from "Well, this is easy" to "WHY IS THIS SO HARD?!"

Your isolation muscles crave sensible loading and with this cable attachment, you can stimulate them to grow instead of annihilating them altogether. The weight stack pin's sleeve fits Olympic weight plates, so you don't need to go out and buy special plates. And if you already have a set of fractional plates, even better!

Oh, and don't worry about scratches. This thing is coated in chrome for extra durability against abrasion.

IMPORTANT: The Weight Stack Pin was designed for micro loading up to 20lbs only. Loading beyond the 20lb limit could permanently damage your weight machine. NEVER use the Weight Stack Pin as a replacement for the selectorized pin.


Guaranteed to fit on:

  • Functional Trainer
  • Lat Pulldown Machine
  • Cable Tower V2 (With laser etched numbers)

It's also compatible with most non-B.o.S. cable machines, provided the depth of the weight stack plates is NOT greater than 4" and fits a selector pin with a 10mm diameter rod. It is not compatible with the V1 cable tower with weight stack (no laser etched numbers, sold 2025 and prior).


Included by default with the Lat Pulldown Machine.

products.title: Cable Pulley
products.body_html:
Perform tricep pushdowns, lat pulldowns, low rows and more using this portable and inexpensive Cable Pulley.

With an unbelievable 440lb weight plate capacity, this cable pulley can be anchored to any power rack or stand-alone pull-up bar and tucked away when not in use. If you don't have the space or budget for a full Cable Machine, this is the solution. Grab two cable pulleys and connect them together for a low row setup and unlock curls, tricep extensions, low rows, pull throughs, and more.

Add an ankle strap to add glute work to the mix. At this price, you can't afford NOT to get two!

IMPORTANT: The cable length on the cable pulley is 1,965mm/77.4" long in order to be compatible with higher attachment points.

products.title: Deadlift Pads (Pair)
products.body_html:
Do your neighbors complain about your earth-shattering PR vibrations? Is your baby's nap time cut short because it's snatch day, and you're causing a ruckus? If you answered "yes" to either of these questions, then I'm afraid the jerk store called, and they're running out of you.

Unlike Stackable Pull Blocks, deadlift pads (AKA silencer pads) let you work out any time of day or night without worrying about disturbing loved ones or sleepy neighbors.

Hefty foam fillers and a durable outer shell withstand heavy drops. Stack them for rack pulls and jerk work with a secure velcro outer edge and hang them up out of the way when not in use.

IMPORTANT: Leaving a loaded barbell on the Deadlift Pads will prematurely wear down the foam and the cover. Sold in pairs.

products.body_html:

A convenient, space-efficient storage solution for NÜOBELL Adjustable Dumbbells.

products.body_html:

products.title: Blitz Magnetic Resistance Manual Treadmill
products.body_html:
Elevate your cardio workouts with the Blitz Magnetic Resistance Manual Treadmill! 6 magnetic resistance levels, so you can walk, jog, sprint, or sled push. Magnetic resistance offers an ultra-smooth and highly responsive experience with minimal maintenance.

The steep 17° curve will light your posterior chain on fire. When you're ready to really feel the burn, crank up the resistance and brace against the padded front handles for a sled push - turning your monotonous cardio workouts into exciting calorie bonfires.

Suitable for commercial facilities, with strong aesthetic finishes, durable aluminum slats encased in rubber for longevity, and a data-rich console. Oh, and that industry standard of only 100 ball bearings for the belt? Yeah, we DOUBLED it for a ride that's smoother than your pickup lines in college.

Made of recycled, non-smelly, consumer-grade rubber, these mats were designed specifically for weightlifting. With ultra-smooth, easy-to-clean fine rubber on the top and larger crumb rubber on the bottom, these bad boys are going nowhere.

The specialized bumps on the bottom help disperse the weight being dropped for less bounce, effective sound dampening, and better drainage in basement and garage gyms. 

Their compact, square design ensures a snug fit in any space. Got a basic bar and plates? Opt for two mats. Rocking a power rack? Go for four.

products.title: Tricep Bar
products.body_html:
This specialty bar delivers all the tricep targeting, with little-to-no joint strain.

products.body_html:
Get your squats droppin' and your booty poppin' with the Glute Loop. Use it for warm-ups to fire up your muscles or create tension during squats and bodyweight work. 
This dual-sided band has a grippy non-slip layer for traction and a slippy non-grip layer to avoid hair pulling. The 2.5" width promises even tension with a durable design that's built to last every lateral walk, fire hydrant, and goblet squat.

products.title: Soft Glute Bench
products.body_html:
Unlock hip thrusts, step-ups, and decline/incline work at home with the Soft Glute Bench. Sure, it was designed specifically for hip thrusts and glute work, but it offers SO much more in a compact, affordable package.

This glute bench is slightly sloped, simplifying the setup for glute bridges & barbell hip thrusts. The short, stable design is ideal for people with short torsos but includes two removable 4" bottom blocks if your torso is longer.

Most important, this hip thrust bench lacks the wobble of a typical bench setup... it's literally got your back(side)!

Pair it with the Band & Strap Pack for even more versatility. Or, build glorious glutes while skipping the hassle of setting up barbell with the Hip Thrust Machine!

IMPORTANT: The Soft Glute Bench has multiple d-rings for attaching resistance bands, but carabiners are only included with the Band & Strap Pack.

products.title: Fixed Barbell Rack
products.body_html:
Like a new parent, the Fixed Barbell Rack will have you showing off your babies with pride. Store up to 10 barbells with a space-efficient, easy-to-access design. The Fixed Barbell Rack can hold fixed barbells or traditional Olympic barbells.

products.title: Foam Roller Storage
products.body_html:
Wall-mounted Foam Roller Storage saves floor space, is adaptable to any foam roller length, and fits foam rollers up to 6" in diameter.  Designed to work like a can dispenser of ye olden days of the 1980s, this storage system will keep your foam rollers neatly stacked and off of the floor, preventing any mishaps that set you a PR in medical bills.

products.title: Four Fold Mat

products.title: Folding Rack 2.3" x 2.3" (5/8" Holes)
products.body_html:

A simple hinge and pin system allows you to quickly remove the pull-up bar after a workout, then fold the sides of the squat rack inwards against the wall to open up a massive amount of space. Superior 1" spacing through the bench and pull zone, and 2" spacing above and below allow you to select the perfect height for your j-cups, for precision lift-offs that can make the difference between a good rep and a superb rep.

products.title: Foam Roller

products.title: Blitz Air Bike
products.body_html:
Overview

Your pain cave deserves better.

The Blitz Air Bike is built to commercial spec — 25" (63.5 cm) fan, belt drive, 350 lb (159 kg) capacity — in a machine priced for your garage, not a commercial facility. Resistance scales with effort. Go easy, get easy. Sprint at full capacity and it'll feel every bit of it.

Belt drive means no chain rattle, NO lubrication, and 5 AM sessions that don't wake up the rest of the house. Which, honestly, might be the feature that wins it for most gym enthusiasts.

No programs. No subscription. No ceiling. Trusted by 250+ gym enthusiasts. Rated 4.8/5.

Best For You If
  • You want serious conditioning without sacrificing home gym space
  • You train early morning or in shared spaces and need quieter than chain-drive
  • You're over 200 lbs and want commercial-grade durability that won't flex under real effort
  • You prefer tracking data (watts, calories, RPM) over following preset programs
  • You're upgrading from a lower-quality air bike and want something that lasts 5–10+ years
Consider Alternatives If
  • You need Bluetooth or app connectivity (the Blitz display is data-focused, not smart-connected)
  • You primarily train low-RPM endurance for extended periods — a dedicated cycling ergometer may suit you better
  • You're buying for a commercial facility with 8+ hours daily use (consider commercial-only options)
Technical Details

The Blitz runs a 25" (63.5 cm) commercial-grade fan paired with a heavy-duty rubber belt drive — resistance scales proportionally with output. Push harder, get more. Belt drive means NO chain stretch, NO lubrication, and a noticeably quieter ride than older-generation air bikes. When the belt eventually needs replacing (and it won't be soon), it's a 20-minute DIY job — not a service call.

The console tracks six metrics live: RPM, speed, distance, calories, watts, and heart rate (pairs with most standard 5kHz chest straps — no subscription required). Seat adjusts across 10 positions on BOTH height and reach. Removable wind guard controls airflow — on for cold garage mornings, off when you want everything the fan can give.

Phone holder and bottle cage ship in the box at no extra cost. At 118 lbs (54 kg) and 53" × 23" × 51" (135 × 58 × 130 cm) assembled, the Blitz stays planted under max effort and rolls when you need to move it — integrated transport wheels included.

Exercise List

High-Intensity & Intervals

  • Tabata intervals (20 sec on / 10 sec off)
  • HIIT sprint intervals
  • AMRAP conditioning rounds
  • Max-effort air bike sprints
  • 30/30 interval training
  • Cross-training WOD cardio (e.g., "30 calories for time")
  • Metabolic conditioning (MetCon)

Aerobic & Endurance

  • Zone 2 aerobic training (sustained 60–70% max HR)
  • Steady-state cardio (20–45 minutes)
  • Low-impact aerobic conditioning
  • Heart rate zone training (paired with HR strap)

Recovery & Conditioning

  • Active recovery between strength training sets
  • Low-intensity movement (joint-friendly, no impact)
  • Concurrent training cardio
  • Post-workout cooldown

Full-Body Movement Patterns

  • Arms-only training (legs stationary)
  • Legs-only training (arms stationary)
  • Simultaneous push-pull arm drive
  • Single-arm intervals

products.title: Belt Squat Belt
products.body_html:
Ditch the barbell – this Belt Squat Belt helps you smash leg day without wrecking your back.

By shifting weight to your hips, a belt squat belt lets you torch your legs while sparing your spine. It’s a game-changer for lifters with back issues or anyone who wants serious leg gains minus the extra strain.

This ain’t your average loading belt; it’s built for blissful belt squatting (and more). The wide 5″ padding hugs your waist to prevent bruising, and extra-long lead straps ensure plates hang at the perfect height without chains digging into your thighs.

The heavy-duty construction — complete with high-strength webbing and steel hardware — is tested up to 700lbs, so feel free to crush those heavyweight squat sets.

Sure, belt squats are the main event, but you can get creative with other lower-body killers too! Strap in for belt squat marches, weighted step-ups, hip belt lunges, or calf raises.

You can even hook it up to a low cable or lever arm for unique squat variations. The only limit is your imagination (and maybe the fact that you’re not 20 anymore).

Included by default with:

IMPORTANT: Ideal for lower body exercises; for hanging exercises (dips & pull-ups), we recommend the Dip Belt instead. The Belt Squat Belt has a weight capacity of 700lbs.

products.body_html:

products.title: Wall or Rack Mounted Bench Hanger
products.body_html:

But if you want to clear floor space entirely, wall mounting is the way to go — especially ideal for commercial gyms managing multiple benches or the taller mounting needed for air rower storage.

products.title: Residential Air Bike with Wind Guard
products.body_html:
Full garage gym or a corner of the living room — the Residential Air Bike doesn't discriminate. It fits, it performs, and it hurts the same either way.

THIS IS BELT-DRIVEN. No chain. No grease. No Saturday afternoon maintenance ritual you've been meaning to do since March. The Residential Air Bike runs on a heavy-duty rubber belt — smoother, quieter, and about as low-maintenance as cardio equipment gets. Your basement neighbours will thank you. (Or at least stop complaining about the 5 a.m. sessions.)

297 LBS / 134.7 KG CAPACITY. 20" fan that scales resistance with your effort — the harder you push, the harder it pushes back. No dials, no settings, no coasting. Just work. The intuitive console tracks your metrics and pairs with heart rate monitors via 5kHz analog frequency, because suffering is better with data.

Built-in wheels mean you can move it when you're done and stop looking at it until next time.

Wind guard, bottle holder, and phone holder ship standard — not as add-ons to argue with a checkout page about. Pull up your intervals. Sit down. Go to work.

Verified reviews with a near-perfect rating. Reviewers call out the quiet operation, the surprisingly solid build quality, and the fact that it works even if you're not 6'2". One customer bought it over the premium model and said they're so glad they went residential. That's the kind of review that means something.

The Residential Air Bike is the smart starting point in the B.o.S. fan bike lineup; same build philosophy as the rest of the range, scaled for home gym use and home gym budgets.

Step up to the Blitz Air Bike for a heavier frame and a larger 25" fan when the residential model isn't enough.

Not sure which one's right for you? The Blitz vs. Residential breakdown makes it easy.

Want to round out your conditioning setup? Pair it with the Residential Manual Treadmill for a full cardio corner that doesn't need a power outlet, a maintenance contract, or a second mortgage.

1-YEAR WARRANTY. Canada flat-rate shipping (capped at $199). Add to cart and meet your new least-favourite piece of equipment.

The 42” and 60” uprights feature 1” hole spacing in the bench zone for precise adjustments, and 2” spacing at the top, bottom, and sides.
