products.title: Crumb Bumper Plates
products.body_html:
It's time to bump up your lifting game. These crumb bumper plates have a thick stainless steel insert ring with 3 anchor points to prevent common bumper breakdowns.

The crumb material is quieter than urethane bumpers. Ideal for lifters who don't have a platform and features coloured flecks for easier weight identification. The number one advantage of bumpers is safety for the lifter. A lifter who hesitates to dump a bad lift because they're afraid of damage to the floor or the equipment is more likely to get hurt.

Bumpers take any worry about damage completely out of the equation.

Iron plates come in a variety of non-standardized diameters, so if you are doing any exercises pulling from the floor, such as deadlifts, or cleans, unless you have 45lb plates on each side, you'll be pulling from a deficit. Not the case here.

Cheap bumpers can be up to 10% off the claimed weight, causing you to put the wrong weight on the bar. Our bumper plates are accurate to +/- 1% of the claimed weight. No more second-guessing what's on the bar - ever.

NOTE: We're discontinuing the 55 LBS plates, so grab yours while supplies last. The Crumb Bumpers are RoHS-compliant.

products.title: Safety Squat Bar - The SS4
products.body_html:
Your spine has opinions. Pinched shoulders, mashed wrists, a low-bar position your mobility hates? The straight bar can be a tax on the rest of your training. The SS4 safety squat bar gets out of the way and lets you squat heavy without paying interest.

1,500 LBS / 680 KG OF CAPACITY. 100,000 PSI tensile steel in the shaft. Needle-bearing sleeves that the competition reserves for bars priced twice as high. (We didn't think you should have to pay double for sleeves that spin right.)

Built right where it counts. Black titanized finish on the shaft AND the sleeves. A high-density shoulder pad that's easy to rack, has great trap contact, and no bar roll. 

PICK YOUR HANDLES. PICK YOUR WORKOUT.

The SS4 ships with a pair of Straight Handles — your everyday squat handle, 7.25" of useable length, knurled for a locked-in grip. Upgrade the setup (and the exercise list) from there:

  • Spider Handles — Long, angled handles that put your hands out in front. Best for lifters who want maximum upper-body involvement, a closer feel to a straight-bar squat, or are working around serious shoulder immobility.
  • Seal Row Handles — Neutral-grip, knurled handles designed for (you guessed it) seal rows. Grab a Seal Row Pad to unlock its full potential. One bar, now a back exercise too.
  • Chain Handles — The most free-moving option. Chains let your hands find their natural position each rep, reducing elbow and wrist stress for lifters who feel even the fixed handles are too rigid.All four styles screw onto the same threaded posts. Swap in 30 seconds, store in a drawer.

One bar. Ten-plus exercises. Squats, good mornings, RDLs, Hatfields, lunges, JM presses, calf raises, hip thrusts. Loop on a set of resistance bands to build accommodating resistance off the floor, hang some weightlifting chains to make lockout the hardest part, or pair it with a plyo box for box squats that actually teach depth. Belt up with the B.o.S. Lever Belt and you've got a serious leg day setup without ever touching a straight bar.

4.9 stars across 80+ reviews. Awarded "Best Versatile Safety Squat Bar" by King of the Gym. Reviewers with elbow tendonitis, scoliosis, and wrecked shoulders use this bar to keep squatting. LIMITED LIFETIME frame warranty. Leg day isn't optional. This bar lets you out-lift your perceived limits.

The All-In-One Trainer is a full-strength training system designed for home lifters who want rack functionality, cable versatility, and commercial-grade performance—all in a compact, corner-friendly footprint. This machine replaces a functional trainer, squat rack, and multiple individual accessories, helping you build a complete strength setup in one piece of equipment without turning your space into an obstacle course.

IMPORTANT: The plate loaded All-In-One Trainer MUST be bolted down to ensure the user and equipment's safety. Both the plate loaded or stack All-in-One Trainer MUST be bolted down if using for barbell exercises to ensure the user and equipment's safety.

Mounting hardware is not included, but we recommend Tapcon+ screws.

Ships unassembled.

The All-In-One Trainer only works with the included lat pulldown bar — it's shortened to fit perfectly between the uprights.

The All-In-One Trainer plate loaded is only compatible with 2" Olympic Plates.

Who It's For

Beginners
Smooth pulleys and adjustable weight options make learning movements safe and approachable.

Intermediate Lifters
Transition quickly between barbell work and cable accessories to build complete strength programs.

Advanced Athletes
True 1:1 and 2:1 pulley ratios, rack-compatible uprights, and durable steel construction support heavy, high-volume training.

Small-Space Users
Corner-fit design optimizes garages, basements, and small-room gyms.

Coaches/Trainers
One machine enables full-body programming for multiple clients.

Cable System
  • Dual pulley system with 2:1 side pulleys for isolation exercises
  • Center pulleys operate at true 1:1 ratio for heavy rows & pulldowns
  • Premium aluminum pulleys ensure long-term smoothness
  • Crossovers, rows, pulldowns, curls, triceps, and fly variations all in one station
Rack Functionality
  • 2.3" × 2.3" uprights with 5/8" holes
  • Compatible with J-cups, spotter arms, dip bars, benches, lever arms, and more
  • Perform squats, bench presses, overhead presses, and pin-based movements
  • Allows barbell training without needing a separate power rack
Weight System Options

Plate-Loaded Version:

  • Lowest cost, highest flexibility
  • Works with standard Olympic plates

Selectorized Weight Stack:

  • Smooth, quick weight changes
  • 210 lb stack

Selectorized Weight Stack Upgrade Kit:

  • Upgrade from plate-loaded to a 210 lb stack at any time
Space & Layout
  • Efficient footprint: 54.6" L × 59" W × 82" H
  • Corner-optimized X-frame puts more training options into less room
  • Ideal for single-car garages, converted offices, and basement gyms
Build Quality & Stability
  • Reinforced steel frame engineered for daily use
  • Premium pulleys and cables eliminate wobble and grinding
  • Limited lifetime frame warranty
  • Requires bolting down for full stability (recommended hardware listed in assembly guide)
Training Possibilities

Perform barbell squats, bench presses, overhead presses, pulldowns, rows, curls, triceps work, fly variations, lunges, belt squats, face pulls, lat raises, and hundreds more movements without needing to change machines.

Assembly & Support
  • Typical assembly time: 150–180 minutes
  • Two-person assembly recommended
  • Clear step-by-step videos and help resources available
  • USA/Canada support team available for replacement parts and assembly questions

products.title: Self Locking Belt
products.body_html:
From powerlifting to conditioning workouts, this belt has your back.
Subpar velcro belts are notorious for not being able to be tightened enough or literally exploding off your body during the middle of a rep — talk about risqué! However, the Bells of Steel self-locking belt sidesteps these two issues completely with the dual safety pin system. 
Unlike a prong lifting belt or lever belt with a fixed number of sizes, our Classic Self Locking Belt offers wayyyyy more customization from its full velcro strip. Whether you're just starting your fitness journey or you're a veteran of the iron game who has never tried a belt, this is a great training accessory to start out with and a solid jack-of-all-trades for back support in your training!

IMPORTANT: Please use the Sizing Chart for a correct fit. Not approved for IPF or IWF competitions.

This bar's unique shape allows you to lift with less strain on your wrists and elbows, and more focus on your working muscles to maximize the stimulation of your biceps and triceps. Use it for standing bicep curls, preacher curls, or pair it with an Arm Blaster. It's not uncommon for a bar to cost as much as your rack. We put UHMW (AKA dense plastic) on the bottom, back and front of our j-cups to ensure fewer scuffs and damage to your bar, better protecting your hard-earned dollars.

Solid steel spotter arms with a secondary steel pipe covering ensures full protection for when you miss that heavy squat. The safety arms ends also act as a second pair of j-cups, making your new rack even more useful.

The residential rack is designed to function optimally without being bolted down, however; optionally bolting down can reduce some shakiness when racking and unracking your bar.

products.title: Powder Coated Kettlebells
products.body_html:
Get the bells that started it all. The B.o.S. premium powder-coated kettlebells give you everything that you're looking for in a non pro-grade kettlebell. 

These kettlebells are designed for all fitness levels, whether you're a beginner just starting out or an experienced athlete looking to elevate your training. They excel at building functional fitness by targeting specific muscle groups, boosting overall strength and endurance, and improving balance, coordination, and stability through a variety of movements. 

They are perfect for any box, gym, or garage. The black powder coat offers rust resistance and a strong grip, while color-coded handles make it easy to identify the weights during fast-paced workouts. 

Gravity-cast in a single mold, these bells are built to outlast the competitors who attach the handles separately. The powder coated kettlebell's ergonomic design and precision construction allows for a seamless workout experience.  

Offering a perfect blend of durability, performance, and style, these kettlebells not only meet the demands of tough training sessions but also inspire confidence as you progress toward your fitness goals. 

Oh, and let's not forget to mention the weight accuracy within 300 grams and the lifetime warranty! *chef's kiss* 


Versatile for a Variety of Workouts 

More than just fitness equipment, a kettlebell set opens up endless possibilities for full-body workouts, circuit training, and strength-focused routines. Here’s how they fit into your fitness plan: 

  • Swings: Build explosive power and endurance while targeting the hips, glutes, and core. 
  • Goblet Squats: Strengthen the legs and engage the core, promoting better stability and functional movement. 
  • Lunges: Improve lower-body strength and balance with dynamic movements that challenge stability. 
  • Overhead Presses: Develop upper body strength and shoulder stability for enhanced posture and endurance. 
  • Russian Twists: Strengthen the core and improve rotational stability for functional athleticism. 
  • Deadlifts: Boost lower back and leg strength to reinforce foundational movements. 
  • Farmer’s Walks: Enhance grip strength, posture, and overall functional fitness with this simple, effective exercise. 

By incorporating these movements, kettlebells become an incredibly versatile tool for targeting multiple muscle groups and achieving a balanced approach to fitness. Whether your goal is quick circuits or focused strength training, these kettlebells complete with a powder coated finish deliver consistent, reliable results that adapt to your needs.

products.title: Magnetic Clamp Collars
products.body_html:
Spring collars are the unsung villain of the home gym. They fight you on the way in, they fight you on the way out, and somewhere between sets they vanish entirely. They're like the single socks of the home gym world. (Still don't know where either goes. Probably the same place.)

Magnetic Clamp Collars fix all three problems at once:

The lever-based quick-release snaps on and off in seconds — one hand, no tools, no new curse words invented mid-set.

The built-in magnets do the rest: stick them to your rack between sets. Always there. Always ready. Never losing your barbell collars is a genuinely underrated quality of life upgrade — ask anyone who's ever hunted for a spring collar while a loaded bar sits waiting.

The rubberized interior isn't just a nice touch — it's doing two real jobs. First, it grips the sleeve so your plates STAY PUT under load. Second, it keeps your barbell scratch-free, which matters when you've invested in a quality bar.

Slim profile means you're not sacrificing sleeve space. Load heavy — the collar stays out of the way.

Available in Black, Blue, and Orange. Colour-code your setup, match your plates, or just pick what looks right. Pro tip: the orange pops nicely against a black rack, if you're the type to lose your glasses when they're on your head.

Fits all standard 2" / 50mm Olympic barbells, including the Arch Nemesis Swiss Bar and lever arm attachments. Every bar worth owning, covered.

Order in pairs, or grab 2, 3, or 10 pairs if you're outfitting a full setup or just done sharing with your training partner.

4.7 stars. 92% recommend. Reviewers consistently mention two things: how much sleeve space the slim profile saves (one lifter switched specifically because low wall clearance made bulkier collars a problem), and how the magnets actually hold on a glossy rack finish — something pricier knurled aluminum alternatives couldn't deliver.

While you're sorting out the small stuff: pair these with workout chalk for a grip that doesn't quit, lifting straps for heavy pulls where your grip would otherwise be the limiting factor, or wrist wraps for pressing days. The full barbell accessories collection has everything else.

products.title: Calibrated Powerlifting Plates - LB
products.body_html:
Wickedly precise and colour-coded, the Calibrated Powerlifting Plates are the perfect training plates for powerlifting.

These babies don't just look amazing, they also closely align with IPF specs and outperform machined iron plates. While they're not IPF-approved, they do check the key boxes: standardized diameters, correct colour-coding, and guaranteed to be within +/-10 grams of the claimed weight.

If you've ever pulled your 1 rep max with iron plates AND with calibrated plates, you know that the two aren't the same. Calibrated plates are thinner and don't extend so far on the sleeves of the bar, so there's less flex in it - making your lifts different and/or noticeably harder. Which is maybe important to know BEFORE you try to hit a personal record on your final pull, ya know? The thing is, they're made in pounds instead of kilograms because, well, #freedomunits. But don't let that rain on your parade, they still make excellent training plates for powerlifting.

To learn more, check out What Are Calibrated Plates.

IMPORTANT: Not IPF approved. Precision-cut 50.4mm centre hole might not fit out-of-spec Olympic barbells.

products.title: Lat Pulldown Low Row Machine
products.body_html:
Overview

The Bells of Steel Lat Pulldown / Low Row Machine is a heavy duty back-training beast built for lifters who want buttery-smooth cable work without sacrificing half their house of gains. With a smooth 310 lb selectorized stack or plate loaded option, adjustable thigh pads, built-in band pegs, and high/low pulley versatility, this machine delivers wide-grip lat work, heavy low rows, arm training, and cable accessory movements — big back energy without the space demands of a full functional trainer.

IMPORTANT: We highly encourage bolting the unit down to ensure the user and equipment's safety. Mounting hardware is not included, but we recommend Tapcon+ screws. Ships unassembled.

Who It's For
  • Beginners — Smooth aluminum pulleys and simple selectorized adjustments make it easy to learn lat pulldowns, rows, and cable accessories with confidence.
  • Intermediate Lifters — Transition quickly between pulldowns, rows, curls, and pressdowns — ideal for structured back and arm programming.
  • Advanced Athletes — A 310 lb stack on the weight stack version, 1:1 pull ratio, reinforced steel construction, and band-peg compatibility provide heavy loading capacity for serious strength work.
  • Small-Space Users — A compact footprint and vertical design maximize usable training area in garages, basements, and single-room home gyms.
  • Coaches & Trainers — Reliable resistance, fast adjustments, and built-in attachment options support multi-client sessions and diverse programming.
Cable System
  • High and low pulleys unlock full back and arm training in one station
  • True 1:1 ratio offers direct, predictable resistance — excellent for heavy rows and strength work
  • High-quality aluminum pulleys ensure long-term smoothness with minimal noise
  • Supports pulldowns, low rows, curls, triceps work, straight-arm variations, and band-augmented power pulls
  • Premium cable routing keeps motion consistent from top to bottom of each rep
Adjustability & User Fit
  • Adjustable thigh pad accommodates a wide range of user heights
  • Optimized seat-to-pulley set-up ensures full range of motion for tall or short lifters
  • Angled low-row footplate provides secure bracing for heavy pulling
  • Quick-change adjustments reduce transition time between exercises
  • Ideal for ceilings 8 ft+ and compact training spaces
Weight System

Selectorized 310 lb Stack Version

  • Instant weight changes with a single pin
  • Consistent 10 lb increments for precise progression
  • No plate loading, no noise, no downtime

Plate-Loaded Version

  • Use Olympic plates you already own at no added cost
  • Scale resistance exactly to your program
  • Train with the same reinforced frame and smooth pulley system

Band-Peg Compatibility

  • Add progressive resistance to pulldowns and rows
  • Increase peak contraction without adding stack weight
  • Matches features offered by high-end competitors at a better value
Exercises You Can Perform
  • Wide-grip lat pulldowns
  • Underhand / close-grip pulldowns
  • Seated low rows
  • Neutral-grip and wide-row variations
  • Straight-arm pulldowns
  • Triceps pressdowns
  • Biceps cable curls
  • Upright rows / face pulls
  • Band-augmented pulldowns or rows
Space & Layout
  • Compact footprint: approx. 41" W × 70" D × 87" H
  • Upright, depth-efficient frame fits seamlessly into garage or basement gym layouts
  • Perfect for users replacing bulky, plate-loaded lat machines with a sleeker, faster-adjusting unit
  • Requires no rack integration — works as a true standalone cable station
Accessory Compatibility
  • Built-in band pegs for added resistance
  • Side attachment holes for optional landmine, dip bars, and modular accessories
  • Works seamlessly with lat bars, handles, tricep ropes, and more carabiner attachments
Assembly & Support
  • Typical assembly time: 90–120 minutes
  • Two-person assembly recommended for weight-stack alignment
  • Includes detailed instructions with exploded diagrams
  • North American support team available for troubleshooting and replacement parts
  • Delivered curbside, packaged securely to prevent damage
Training Possibilities

Build a complete upper-body program using just this machine — lat pulldowns, rows, pullover variations, cable curls, triceps work, shoulder movements, and band-powered resistance training. Whether used as a primary back station or paired with a squat rack and bench, this machine fills a critical role in any serious home gym setup.

Build Quality & Stability
  • Reinforced steel frame engineered for daily, high-volume training
  • Aluminium pulleys and commercial-grade cables deliver long-term durability
  • Stable under heavy rows thanks to wide base
  • Limited lifetime frame warranty for confidence in long-term investment
  • Black powder-coat finish resists chips and wear in high-use environments

products.title: Fractional Iron Plates - 0.5 LB
products.body_html:
Listen, buddy - I get it. You never thought that you'd need smaller weight plates than 2.5lbs. After all, change plates cover your bases pretty well already.

But haven't you wondered why your arm and shoulder strength always lag behind? Sure, these are smaller muscle groups than those in your legs. But their lack of progress mostly boils down to getting pummelled by the same loading scheme used to progress squats and deadlifts, by adding 2.5-5lbs per side.

Instead of forcing 5-10lb jumps on overhead presses and biceps curls, these lifts should be loaded in a more sensible way - by adding weight in smaller increments of 1-4lbs.

Fractional cast iron plates that fit Olympic barbells, with a guaranteed weight tolerance of +/-16 grams.

IMPORTANT: Because they're cast iron instead of machined, some minor blemishes, a +/-16 gram weight tolerance & 52mm centre hole are standard for them.

products.title: Manticore Flat Foot Components
products.body_html:
Upgrade your non-flat-foot Manticore (or 3"x3" with 1" holes) power racks with our flat foot support system. Grab a pair of flat feet, some reinforcement plates, and an optional cross-member to hold everything together.

The flat feet come in 54" and 63" lengths, with an optional 43" flat foot crossmember to connect them for added stability.

The 54" length can be paired with the 24" and 30" crossmember depths, while the 63" length can be paired with the 24", 30" and 43" depths.

You can select the flat foot with a bottom cross member that connects the 2 feet for increased stability, or leave it out. However, the bottom cross member is NOT compatible with the lat pulldown attachment - you'll need a rear base stabilizer instead.


Popular combos are:

  • 43" with a 63" flat foot for maximum roominess.
  • 30" with the 54" flat foot for maximum stability and minimal space.
  • Or get a little weird with the 24" depth and 54" flat foot.

IMPORTANT: The flat foot support system adds 3-1/4" to the overall height of your rack. Compatible with non-Flat Foot Manticore power racks only. Reinforcement plates are required for stability and include necessary hardware for overall assembly.

products.title: Machined Iron Olympic Weight Plates
products.body_html:
Weight is weight, right? But what if I told you your sloppy, 45lb plates you got for your 16th birthday from the local big box store were lying to you? The process of casting molten hot iron into moulds can be fickle.

Machined iron plates are cast in a specialty casting factory with over 40 years of experience, then finished on a lathe that shaves off excessive weight from the back of the plate, followed by polishing and machining edges for an even smoother, more aesthetic plate.

The machined plates have a guaranteed tolerance of +/- 1% for 45, 35, and 25 and +/- 3% for 15, 10, 5, and 2.5. But we don't stop there; the holes of the plates are cast smaller than the Olympic bar sleeve diameter of 2 inch/50mm to start, then are drilled out with a guaranteed precision hole fit of 50.5mm +.4mm tolerance, meaning your plates fit snug and erect on your bar. Finally, these beauties are 20% slimmer than other weight plates to fit more on your barbell.

If you're looking for an excellent quality but more economical plate, be sure to check out the Mighty Grip Iron Plates.

products.title: Weightlifting Chains
products.body_html:
Our rust-resistant, zinc-plated chains are perfect for busting through sticking points and plateaus by adding progressive resistance to your training regimen.

Choose sets ranging from 5lbs to 107lbs, with an easy-to-use feeder chain for easy loading.

Similar to resistance bands, the chains you are lifting progressively become heavier, providing maximum muscular stimulation throughout the entire range of motion. At the bottom of a squat or bench, the chains pool on the floor and ease the burden. Near the top, things get HEAVY. They also look and sound totally badass.

 

How much chain do I need?

If you bench press Chain Weight
Under 200lbs bench 20-30 lbs
200-400lbs bench 40-50 lbs
400-500lbs bench 80-90 lbs
+500lbs bench 80-90 lbs

If you squat Chain Weight
Under 200lbs squat 40-50 lbs
200-400lbs squat 50-60 lbs
400-500lbs squat 60-70 lbs
500-600lbs squat 80-90 lbs
600-700lbs squat 90-100 lbs
+700lbs squat 120 -140 lbs

products.title: Buzz-Saw Heavy-Duty Adjustable Bench
products.body_html:
Overview

The Buzz-Saw Bench is a heavy-duty adjustable bench engineered for lifters who prioritize stability, pad performance, and long-term durability over unnecessary gimmicks. Built from thick 11-gauge steel with a reinforced stabilizer foot and a high-density, stay-put pad, it delivers that locked-in confidence you want when the weight gets spicy — without stealing your floor space or your grocery money.

Add optional attachments for preacher curls, leg extensions and curls, decline sit-ups, and Bulgarian split squats, and suddenly your "bench" is pulling double (okay, quadruple) duty. Whether you're pressing heavy, training incline movements, or building a serious home gym, the Buzz-Saw Bench is designed to stay locked in place and perform consistently under load.

IMPORTANT: If storing vertically, ensure your floor is level. Uneven flooring may cause the bench to fall when stored upright.

Who It's For
  • Beginner Lifters — A stable, forgiving platform that helps build pressing mechanics with confidence and consistency.
  • Intermediate Lifters — Multiple back and seat adjustments support progressive overload across flat, incline, and seated movements.
  • Powerlifters & Heavy Pressers — Optimized bench height, minimal pad shift, and zero side-to-side wobble under leg drive.
  • Home Gym Owners — Commercial-grade construction that fits comfortably in a garage or basement gym with optional attachments for more versatility in limited space.
  • Coaches & Trainers — Durable enough for repeated daily use with fast, intuitive adjustments between clients.
Build Quality & Materials

The Buzz-Saw Bench is constructed from thick 11-gauge steel tubing with reinforced weld points to maximize rigidity and long-term structural integrity. The wide front foot and rear stabilizer design distribute load evenly, reducing movement under dynamic pressing and incline work.

The bench pad uses a high-density foam core wrapped in a textured, grippy upholstery that resists slipping during leg drive and high-incline angles. Hardware tolerances are intentionally tight to minimize rattle, squeaks, and play over time.

This is a bench designed to feel heavy, planted, and confidence-inspiring — because stability directly impacts performance and safety.

Adjustment System & User Experience

The Buzz-Saw Bench features a ladder-style back adjustment with clearly visible, laser-etched angle markings. This allows for fast setup, repeatable positioning, and accurate progression when programming incline or shoulder movements.

The seat adjusts independently to support proper torso positioning across flat and incline configurations, helping reduce lower-back strain and improve pressing mechanics.

Despite its solid weight and premium feel, integrated wheels and a front handle make repositioning the bench quick and manageable within a home gym.

Pad Design & Lifting Feel

Unlike softer, overly cushioned benches that compress unpredictably, the Buzz-Saw Bench pad is tuned for firm support with controlled grip.

  • Maintains shape under heavy loads
  • Prevents sliding during aggressive leg drive
  • Comfortable across high-rep and heavy single sessions

A minimal pad gap between seat and backrest helps maintain comfort during flat and incline transitions without interfering with range of motion.

Space, Assembly & Practical Considerations

The Buzz-Saw Bench is designed to fit comfortably in most home gym layouts without sacrificing stability. Assembly is straightforward with clearly labeled hardware, and the bench arrives mostly pre-assembled to reduce setup time.

Its balance of heft and mobility makes it easy to reposition between lifts while remaining rock-solid once in place.

How It Compares

The Buzz-Saw Bench was designed to meet or exceed the expectations set by higher-priced adjustable benches, while focusing on the features lifters actually feel during training.

Feature Buzz-Saw Bench Typical Premium Adjustable Bench
Frame Construction Thick-gauge steel with reinforced stabilizer Varies by model
Stability Under Load Wide stance + stabilizer foot minimizes wobble Can shift under heavy leg drive
Pad Material High-density, grippy upholstery Often smoother or softer
Angle Markings Permanent laser-etched indicators Stickers or no markings
Pad Gap Minimal and optimized Often larger or unaddressed
Mobility Wheels + handle included Sometimes optional
Noise & Play Tight tolerances, low rattle Can loosen over time
Footprint Home-gym friendly Often bulkier
Price-to-Performance Commercial feel without commercial pricing Higher cost for similar performance
Why Choose This Over a Standard Adjustable Bench

Compared to entry-level or mid-tier adjustable benches, the Buzz-Saw Bench offers:

  • Greater stability during heavy pressing
  • Firmer, more supportive pad construction
  • Clear angle markings for repeatable setups
  • Reduced wobble and long-term hardware looseness
  • Higher confidence under dynamic and high-load movements
  • Compatible attachments for a full-body training eco-system

If you're training seriously and expect your bench to last for years — not seasons — the Buzz-Saw Bench represents a meaningful upgrade.

What You Can Do With the Buzz-Saw Bench
  • Flat barbell bench press
  • Incline barbell bench press
  • Flat & incline dumbbell press
  • Seated shoulder press
  • Chest-supported rows
  • Dumbbell flyes
  • Bulgarian split squats
  • Seated curls
  • Tricep extensions
  • Core movements (incline sit-ups, leg raises)
Warranty & Support

The Buzz-Saw Bench is backed by Bells of Steel's commitment to long-term durability and responsive customer support. Built to handle years of heavy training — and supported if you ever need it.

products.title: Functional Trainer
products.body_html:
Missing the commercial gym cable machines? That's what a functional trainer is for. And if you're building a serious cable machine for your home gym, this is where to start.

Two independent cables. 16 height positions per side. ONE dual cable machine that covers rehab, sport-specific training, bodybuilding, and everything in between. This is a Choose Your Own Adventure — and it has a lot of chapters.

TWO VERSIONS. ONE STANDARD. 

  • Weight Stack → 160 LBS per stack, pin-loaded, no plate math required. Move the pin, grab the handle, go. The definition of bougie convenience — and worth every penny of it.
  • Plate-Loaded → The plate loaded functional trainer that lets you keep costs low and make the most of the iron you already own. You can always start with plate-loaded and upgrade later with the Weight Stack Upgrade Kit.

BUILT FOR THE LONG HAUL.

14-gauge steel rails. Aluminum pulleys with high-quality bearings stay buttery smooth, session after session. A 2:1 pull ratio that makes every position feel dialled in. This isn't a cable crossover machine that creaks after a year. It just works.

16 HEIGHT SETTINGS PER CABLE.

Low to high, close grip to wide, unilateral to bilateral — the adjustment range is the whole point. Cable crossovers. Lat pulldowns. Seated rows. Face pulls. Tricep pushdowns. Woodchops. Lateral raises. Bicep curls. Chest flyes. Rear delt work.

The tower uprights are compatible with 2.3” rack attachments for even more exercise versatility. We recommend the Y Dip, the Seal Row Pad, and the Landmine Attachment for this multi-purpose marvel.

Hundreds of exercises, one footprint. It’s the kind of functional trainer home gym setup that makes everything else feel like overkill.

Four welded attachment hooks in the centre of the frame keep your cable attachments within arm's reach. With 20+ options to choose from — ropes, bars, handles, straps — you'll need the storage. A multi-grip pull-up bar unlocks your back, biceps, core, and grip work when you're done with the cables.

Verified reviews with a near-perfect rating. Lifters consistently mention two things: how smooth the pull feels out of the box, and how many exercises they didn't realize they were missing until they had one.

Need a machine that doubles as a squat stand? Check out the All-in-One Trainer. It adds full rack functionality to the same cable footprint.

Prefer dedicated back-and-cable work? The Lat Pulldown / Low Row Machine is purpose-built for exactly that.

LIMITED LIFETIME frame warranty. Pick your version and get pulling.

products.title: Weighted Workout Body Bars
products.body_html:
Level up with a Body Bar! And no, we're not talking about your shower routine.

If you're looking for a simple and effective way to spice up your workouts, look no further than body bars. These are solid steel bars coated with rubber that can be used for a wide range of exercises and movements.

Body bars are great for strength training, conditioning, and mobility. Use them for basic exercises, such as squats, lunges, presses, curls, and rows, or for more advanced ones, such as Turkish get-ups, wood chops, or overhead carries. Mix and match them with other fitness gear, such as resistance bands, stability balls, or benches, for endless workouts.

Body bars come in different weights and are color-coded, so you can easily find the one that matches your fitness level.

products.title: Axle Bars
products.body_html:
With Axle Bars, you'll be one step closer to unlocking that party trick of tearing a phonebook in half - you're welcome.

Whether you're into grappling sports, arm wresting, or just want to build your grip strength, axle bars are a game-changer. Their unique design builds your grip in ways that typical Olympic barbells can't match.

They're offered in two lengths: short (60") for better portability and long (84"), but only the LONG axle bar fits correctly in a power rack.

And unlike an Olympic barbell, the sleeves don't spin on axle bars, which offers an interesting twist on those traditional barbell-based exercises. So even if you're not training for strongman/strongwoman, you can still benefit from it.

And if you already enjoy lifting weird and awkward things like kegs, sandbags, and little children large furniture items, then you'll most certainly enjoy using axle bars.

IMPORTANT: Olympic bar collars are compatible with the Hollow Axle Bars, axle collars are NOT required. Please note that metal-on-metal contact on the sleeves (like loading & unloading weight plates) will cause wearing of the finish over time.

featured_image.alt: The Bells of Steel Axle Bars are long, straight black barbells with smooth sleeves on both ends, designed for weightlifting and strongman training. Shown diagonally on a white background.
The Bells of Steel Axle Bar, shown in black on a white background with two spaced collars and angled towards the camera, is ideal for strongman training and grip strength.

products.title: Arch Nemesis Swiss Bar
products.body_html:
Iffy shoulders? Or great shoulders you'd like to KEEP that way? The straight bar wasn't built for everybody, and after enough pressing sessions, the wear shows up in places your warm-up can't fix.

The Arch Nemesis Swiss Bar is the answer.

THREE angled neutral grips (also known as a football bar or multi-grip bar. Same idea, same shoulder-saving logic). A built-in cable hook that turns one bar into a half-dozen lifts. Cambered design that finds the angle your shoulders actually want (turns out it's not the same angle a flat bar forces on them).

Coarse knurling. Glossy powder coat. Laser-cut end caps. 49.7 mm sleeves that accept any standard Olympic plate and collar. 600 lbs / 272 kg capacity. LIMITED LIFETIME frame warranty.

Swiss bar bench press. Bent-over rows. Overhead press. Tricep work. Hook it to your cable tower for lat pulldowns. Suspension push-ups. Inverted rows. At 24 lbs / 10 kg, it's light enough to clip to a cable — and heavy enough to load hard.

4.7 stars from 200+ lifters. The reviews keep saying the same thing: "this Swiss bar saved my pressing." Combat athletes. Post-surgery lifters. Anyone with cranky shoulders. The arch finds the angle that works.

Pair it with the B.o.S. Belt Squat Machine or the Lat Pulldown / Low Row Machine for the full specialty stack. It will work with any competitors' cable machine that uses a carabiner (traitor). Or just rack it up tomorrow morning and feel the difference on rep one.

Want to learn more about specialty bars? Then read our article: Best Specialty Barbells for Strength Training.


IMPORTANT: The sleeves on the Arch Nemesis Bar won't rotate like a barbell sleeve but have a 49.7mm diameter, so Olympic collars will fit correctly. This means axle collars are NOT needed.
